papers.abstract_original: We define accrual duration as the length of time between an accrual and its associated cash flow. Accrual duration is inextricably linked to accrual discretion and accrual quality by the fundamentals of the accrual process—the recording of longer-duration accruals involves using longer-term estimates, which makes them relatively more discretionary and less reliable, ceteris paribus. We provide the theoretical development of this broad idea and demonstrate several empirical applications linking accrual duration to earnings persistence, Accounting and Auditing Enforcement Releases, asset write-offs, and the observed kink in the earnings distribution. A major advantage of the accrual duration approach is that it is quite general, which allows us to derive a powerful new model of total accruals discretion and quality as well as a novel measure of total accruals duration. Finally, we discuss how the accrual duration approach can illuminate numerous ongoing issues in accounting research.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们将应计持续时间定义为一项应计与其相关现金流之间的时间长度。应计持续时间与应计裁量权和应计质量通过应计过程的基本原理密不可分——记录持续时间较长的应计涉及使用较长期限的估计，这使得它们在其他条件不变的情况下相对更具裁量性且可靠性更低。我们提供了这一宽泛思想的理论发展，并展示了若干实证应用，将应计持续时间与盈余持续性、会计与审计执法公告、资产减记以及盈余分布中观察到的拐点联系起来。应计持续时间方法的一个主要优势在于它相当具有一般性，这使我们能够推导出一个关于总应计裁量权和质量的强有力的新模型，以及一个关于总应计持续时间的新颖度量。最后，我们讨论了应计持续时间方法如何能够阐明会计研究中众多持续存在的问题。

papers.abstract_original: This study investigates the influence of central bank private-sector quantitative easing (QE) policies on firms’ voluntary disclosures. While the effects of QE on borrowing costs and asset prices are well documented, spillovers in the disclosure realm remain understudied. This study specifically analyzes the effects of the Corporate Sector Purchase Program (CSPP), a private-sector QE policy implemented by the European Central Bank (ECB) in 2016 targeting corporate bonds in the euro area. Applying a difference-in-differences methodology to pre- and post-CSPP periods, I find that firms whose bonds the central bank purchased under the CSPP decreased their voluntary disclosures, particularly those related to cash flows and liabilities. My analysis attributes this decrease to reduced demand for firm-specific information from the central bank. My findings highlight the indirect consequences of QE monetary policy tools on corporate disclosure and contribute to the understanding of the transmission of monetary policy and investor-clientele dynamics.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究考察中央银行私人部门量化宽松（QE）政策对企业自愿披露的影响。尽管量化宽松对借款成本和资产价格的影响已有充分文献记载，但其在披露领域的溢出效应仍研究不足。本研究具体分析了企业部门购买计划（CSPP）的影响，这是欧洲中央银行（ECB）于2016年实施的一项私人部门量化宽松政策，针对欧元区的公司债券。我将双重差分方法应用于CSPP实施前后时期，发现其债券被中央银行根据CSPP购买的企业减少了自愿披露，尤其是与现金流和负债相关的披露。我的分析将这一减少归因于中央银行对企业特定信息需求的下降。我的发现凸显了量化宽松货币政策工具对企业披露的间接后果，并有助于理解货币政策的传导以及投资者客户群动态。

papers.abstract_original: Using the market values of audit partners’ houses as a measure of their personal wealth, we find that wealthier U.S. partners provide higher-quality audits, as evidenced by fewer material restatements, fewer material SEC comment letters, and higher audit fees. A battery of falsification tests shows that these findings are not driven by the matching of wealthier partners with clients with higher financial reporting quality. Our additional analyses suggest two explanations: greater personal wealth both incentivizes partners to exert more effort in delivering high-quality audits and reveals partners’ audit competence.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们以审计合伙人住房的市场价值作为其个人财富的衡量指标，发现更富有的美国合伙人提供更高质量的审计，其证据是更少的重大重述、更少的重大SEC意见函以及更高的审计费用。一系列证伪检验表明，这些发现并非由更富有的合伙人与财务报告质量更高的客户相匹配所驱动。我们的进一步分析提出了两种解释：更大的个人财富既激励合伙人在提供高质量审计时付出更多努力，也揭示了合伙人的审计胜任能力。

papers.abstract_original: We examine how locked-in CEO equity attributable to large unrealized capital gains tax liabilities influences the cost and restrictiveness of debt contracts. We find that firms enjoy lower loan spreads and are more (less) likely to receive ratings upgrades (downgrades) when their CEO has a large tax burden. Using the capital gains tax rate decrease in the Tax Reform Act of 1997 as an exogenous shock to CEO tax burdens, we find that CEOs with large tax burdens before the tax cut experience a sharp increase in loan spreads afterward. This increase in spreads is larger when the firm has low profitability, high bankruptcy risk, and when loans are unsecured. Further, CEO tax burdens decrease the restrictiveness of nonprice loan terms, increase syndicate size, and decrease issue costs.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考察由大额未实现资本利得税负债所导致的CEO锁定股权如何影响债务契约的成本与限制性。我们发现，当CEO承担较大税负时，企业享有更低的贷款利差，并且更（更不）可能获得评级上调（下调）。利用1997年《税收改革法案》中资本利得税率的下降作为对CEO税负的外生冲击，我们发现，在减税前承担较大税负的CEO在减税后贷款利差急剧上升。当企业盈利能力低、破产风险高以及贷款为无担保时，这种利差上升幅度更大。此外，CEO税负降低了非价格贷款条款的限制性，增加了银团规模，并降低了发行成本。

papers.abstract_original: Current corporate disclosures regarding carbon emissions lack generally accepted accounting rules. The transactional carbon accounting system described here takes the rules of historical cost accounting for operating assets as a template for generating carbon emissions (CE) statements comprising a balance sheet and a flow statement. The asset side of the CE balance sheet reports the carbon emissions embodied in operating assets. The liability side conveys the firm’s cumulative direct emissions into the atmosphere as well as the cumulative emissions embodied in goods acquired from suppliers less those sold to customers. Flow statements report the company’s annual corporate carbon footprint calculated as the cradle-to-gate carbon footprint of goods sold during the current period. Taken together, balance sheets and flow statements generate key performance indicators of a company’s past, current, and future performance in the domain of carbon emissions.
papers.abstract_zh: 当前关于碳排放的企业披露缺乏公认的会计规则。本文所描述的交易性碳核算系统以经营资产历史成本会计的规则为模板，生成由资产负债表和流量表组成的碳排放（CE）报表。碳排放资产负债表的资产方报告经营资产中所体现的碳排放。负债方传达企业向大气中的累计直接排放，以及从供应商处购得的商品中所体现的累计排放减去出售给客户的商品中所体现的累计排放。流量表报告公司年度企业碳足迹，其计算方式为当期售出商品从摇篮到大门的碳足迹。资产负债表与流量表相结合，可生成公司在碳排放领域过去、当前和未来表现的关键绩效指标。

papers.abstract_original: From 2008 to 2020, 180 of S&P 1500 have disclosed employee diversity targets. We conduct the first analysis of firms’ employee diversity targets and ask three research questions: (i) who announces diversity targets? (ii) do firms deliver on their diversity targets? (iii) what are the implications of disclosure of such targets for employee hiring and investors? We find that firms with a greater willingness (proxied by past ESG penalties, higher CEO-to-median employee pay ratio, more media coverage, and after #MeToo and Black Lives Matter movements) and ability (proxied by financial strength, a blue-collar heavy labor force, and gender and ethnic minorities on boards) to improve employee diversity are more likely to disclose diversity targets. Exploiting the Revelio dataset of 15,639 firm-years for 1,203 distinct firms from 2008 to 2020, we observe that firms that disclosed a diversity target have indeed hired more diverse employees, but such diversity levels had already increased substantially prior to the target disclosure. Firms with numerical, forward-looking, and rank-and-file employee-targeted goals are associated with greater employee diversity relative to firms that announce other types of diversity goals. Moreover, improved diversity performance does not appear to occur at the cost of employee quality, as measured by Revelio. Overall our results have practical implications for how investors and stakeholders might want to interpret corporate diversity targets.
papers.abstract_zh: 从2008年到2020年，标普1500指数中有180家公司披露了员工多元化目标。我们首次对公司员工多元化目标进行了分析，并提出三个研究问题：（i）谁宣布多元化目标？（ii）公司是否兑现了其多元化目标？（iii）披露此类目标对员工招聘和投资者有何影响？我们发现，更有意愿（以过去的ESG处罚、更高的CEO与员工薪酬中位数之比、更多的媒体报道以及#MeToo和Black Lives Matter运动之后为代理变量）和更有能力（以财务实力、蓝领劳动力占比较高以及董事会中的性别和族裔少数群体为代理变量）改善员工多元化的公司更可能披露多元化目标。利用Revelio数据集，涵盖2008年至2020年间1,203家不同公司的15,639个公司-年度观测值，我们观察到，披露了多元化目标的公司确实雇用了更多元化的员工，但在目标披露之前，这种多元化水平已经大幅提高。与宣布其他类型多元化目标的公司相比，具有数值化、前瞻性且针对普通员工的目标的公司与更高的员工多元化相关。此外，以Revelio衡量的员工质量来看，多元化绩效的改善似乎并未以牺牲员工质量为代价。总体而言，我们的结果对投资者和利益相关者应如何解读企业多元化目标具有实践意义。

papers.abstract_original: Standard Bayesians’ beliefs converge when they receive the same piece of new information. However, when agents initially disagree and have uncertainty about the precision of a signal, their disagreement might instead increase, despite receiving the same information. We demonstrate that this divergence of beliefs leads to a unimodal effect of the absolute surprise in the signal on trading volume. We show that this prediction is consistent with the empirical evidence using trading volume around earnings announcements of U.S. firms. We find evidence of elevated volume following moderate surprises and depressed volume following more extreme surprises, a pattern that is more pronounced when investors hold more distant prior beliefs and are more uncertain about earnings’ precision. The evidence is consistent with the model where investors disagree about stocks’ expected returns and do not know the precision of earnings as a signal about the firm’s value.
papers.abstract_zh: 标准贝叶斯主义者在收到同一条新信息时，其信念会趋于一致。然而，当代理人最初就存在分歧，且对信号精度存在不确定性时，即使收到相同的信息，他们的分歧反而可能加大。我们证明，这种信念分歧会导致信号的绝对意外程度对交易量产生单峰效应。我们表明，这一预测与美国公司盈余公告前后的交易量经验证据相一致。我们发现，在中等程度的意外之后交易量上升，而在更极端的意外之后交易量下降，当投资者持有更远的先验信念且对盈余精度更加不确定时，这一模式更为明显。该证据与这样一个模型相一致：投资者对股票的预期收益存在分歧，并且不知道作为公司价值信号的盈余的精度。

papers.abstract_original: ChatGPT frequently appears in the media, with many predicting significant disruptions, especially in the fields of accounting and auditing. Yet research has demonstrated relatively poor performance of ChatGPT on student assessment questions. We extend this research to examine whether more recent ChatGPT models and capabilities can pass major accounting certification exams including the Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Certified Management Accountant (CMA), Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), and Enrolled Agent (EA) certification exams. We find that the ChatGPT 3.5 model cannot pass any exam (average score across all assessments of 53.1%). However, with additional enhancements, ChatGPT can pass all sections of each tested exam: moving to the ChatGPT 4 model improved scores by an average of 16.5%, providing 10-shot training improved scores an additional 6.6%, and allowing the model to use reasoning and acting (e.g., allow ChatGPT to use a calculator and other resources) improved scores an additional 8.9%. After all these improvements, ChatGPT passed all exams with an average score of 85.1%. This high performance indicates that ChatGPT has sufficient capabilities to disrupt the accounting and auditing industries, which we discuss in detail. This research provides practical insights for accounting professionals, investors, and stakeholders on how to adapt and mitigate the potential harms of this technology in accounting and auditing firms.
papers.abstract_zh: ChatGPT频繁出现在媒体上，许多人预测其将带来重大颠覆，尤其是在会计和审计领域。然而，研究表明ChatGPT在学生评估问题上的表现相对较差。我们扩展了这项研究，考察较新的ChatGPT模型和功能能否通过主要的会计认证考试，包括注册会计师（CPA）、注册管理会计师（CMA）、注册内部审计师（CIA）和注册税务师（EA）认证考试。我们发现，ChatGPT 3.5模型无法通过任何考试（所有评估的平均得分为53.1%）。然而，通过额外的增强，ChatGPT可以通过每项受测考试的所有部分：改用ChatGPT 4模型使得分平均提高16.5%，提供10次示例训练使得分再提高6.6%，允许模型使用推理和行动（例如，允许ChatGPT使用计算器和其他资源）使得分再提高8.9%。经过所有这些改进后，ChatGPT通过了所有考试，平均得分为85.1%。这种高性能表明ChatGPT具备足够的颠覆会计和审计行业的能力，我们对此进行了详细讨论。这项研究为会计专业人士、投资者和利益相关者提供了实用见解，说明如何适应并减轻这项技术在会计和审计事务所中的潜在危害。

papers.abstract_original: Decentralized finance (DeFi) has emerged to offer traditional financial services such as lending, borrowing, and trading without intermediaries (e.g., banks). DeFi transactions are typically executed using a special digital class of contracts called smart contracts. These contracts are self-executing and hard-coded directly on a blockchain. We observe the emergence of a new class of voluntary audits that evaluate the integrity of these contracts. Using a hand-coded sample of about 8,500 smart contract audit reports, we provide some of the first evidence showing that (1) these audits are pervasive, (2) the audit firm market is composed of new technical audit firms, (3) the scope of these audits can span a variety of contract features, (4) the audit inputs and outputs differ substantively from those of conventional financial audits, and (5) the market reacts positively to the release of these audit reports, suggesting that these reports are value-relevant. These findings highlight the demand for novel assurance services driven by blockchain technology.
papers.abstract_zh: 去中心化金融（DeFi）的出现，旨在无需中介（如银行）的情况下提供借贷、交易等传统金融服务。DeFi交易通常使用一类特殊的数字合约——智能合约来执行。这些合约可自动执行，并直接硬编码在区块链上。我们观察到一类新型自愿性审计的出现，用以评估这些合约的完整性。基于约8,500份智能合约审计报告的人工编码样本，我们提供了首批证据，表明：(1) 这些审计已十分普遍；(2) 审计事务所市场由新兴的技术型审计事务所构成；(3) 这些审计的范围可涵盖多种合约特征；(4) 其审计投入与产出在实质上不同于传统财务审计；(5) 市场对这些审计报告的发布反应积极，表明这些报告具有价值相关性。这些发现凸显了由区块链技术驱动的新型鉴证服务的需求。

papers.abstract_original: While the production of credit ratings has long been limited mainly to rating agencies (CRAs), recent years have seen the growing popularity of consensus credit ratings crowdsourced from banks (i.e., bank ratings). We provide the first comprehensive examination of the properties and informativeness of bank ratings relative to CRA ratings. We find that bank ratings often deviate from CRA ratings, with over 60% of firm-months having different bank and CRA ratings. These deviations contain useful information. Bank ratings improve out-of-sample prediction of defaults and CRA rating revisions and explain the cross-section of credit spreads. However, bank ratings do not improve out-of-sample prediction of credit excess returns, indicating that current prices incorporate bank rating information. Overall our findings suggest that bank ratings are a useful supplement to traditional credit ratings.
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管信用评级的生成长期以来主要局限于评级机构（CRAs），但近年来，来自银行的众包共识信用评级（即银行评级）日益流行。我们首次对银行评级相对于CRA评级的属性与信息含量进行了全面考察。我们发现，银行评级常常偏离CRA评级，超过60%的公司-月份存在银行评级与CRA评级不同的情况。这些偏离包含有用信息。银行评级改善了违约和CRA评级调整的样本外预测，并解释了信用利差的横截面。然而，银行评级并未改善信用超额收益的样本外预测，这表明当前价格已纳入银行评级信息。总体而言，我们的发现表明，银行评级是对传统信用评级的有益补充。

papers.abstract_original: Activist investors in a firm often voluntarily release information about their governance intentions to the public. Voluntary disclosure theory suggests that an activist investor will disclose when she expects other investors to respond positively and support her in upcoming corporate control contests. We find that activists’ disclosures are accompanied by positive abnormal returns, reductions in bid-ask spreads, and increases in future earnings relative to similar targets without voluntary activist disclosures. Disclosures by activists who demand a board seat (the most common demand) have the highest announcement returns, and disclosers also win proxy contests and directorships more frequently than non-disclosers. These findings suggest that the activist’s beliefs about investor response in both pricing and voting are an important driver of her disclosure choice.
papers.abstract_zh: 公司中的激进投资者往往会自愿向公众发布有关其治理意图的信息。自愿披露理论表明，当激进投资者预期其他投资者会积极回应并在即将到来的公司控制权争夺中支持她时，她就会进行披露。我们发现，与没有激进投资者自愿披露的类似目标公司相比，激进投资者的披露伴随着正的异常收益、买卖价差的缩小以及未来盈利的增加。要求获得董事会席位（最常见的要求）的激进投资者的披露具有最高的公告收益，并且披露者比非披露者更频繁地赢得代理权争夺和董事职位。这些发现表明，激进投资者对投资者在定价和投票两方面反应的信念，是她披露选择的重要驱动因素。

papers.abstract_original: Merkley et al. ( 2023 ) examine how cryptocurrency influencers recommend digital coins on Twitter (X) and the associated price effects. They report that influencers may exploit market investors via potential pump and dump schemes. While plausible, researchers may develop a broader understanding of influencers’ incentives and their influence by considering how investors engage these markets for social identity needs that enhance utility. Social-psychological research indicates that someone’s social identity strongly influences their behavior, even making the behavior maladaptive. This paper discusses how crypto influencers create social identity resonance. It then discusses how influencers can leverage this resonance for potentially lucrative financial opportunities, which might manifest in different expected crypto price patterns. The paper concludes by recommending more research on influencers’ experience, networks, and communication choices; the effects of video relative to text communication; and implications of social identity cohorts that influence prices and undermine regulatory trust in traditional markets.
papers.abstract_zh: Merkley等人（2023）考察了加密货币影响者如何在Twitter（X）上推荐数字代币以及相关的价格效应。他们报告称，影响者可能通过潜在的拉高出货计划来利用市场投资者。尽管这一观点看似合理，但研究者可以通过考虑投资者如何为满足增强效用的社会身份需求而参与这些市场，来对影响者的激励及其影响力形成更广泛的理解。社会心理学研究表明，一个人的社会身份会强烈影响其行为，甚至使行为变得适应不良。本文讨论了加密货币影响者如何创造社会身份共鸣。随后，本文讨论了影响者如何利用这种共鸣来获取可能有利可图的金融机会，这可能表现为不同的预期加密货币价格模式。本文最后建议对影响者的经历、网络和沟通选择；视频相对于文本沟通的效果；以及影响价格并削弱对传统市场监管信任的社会身份群体的含义进行更多研究。

papers.abstract_original: This study examines the investment value of information provided by crypto-influencers, that is, social media influencers covering crypto assets on Twitter. We examine the returns associated with approximately 36,000 tweets issued by 180 of the most prominent crypto social media influencers covering over 1,600 crypto assets for the two years spanning through December 2022. Our primary results indicate that crypto-influencers’ tweets are initially associated with positive returns. However, these tweets are followed by significant negative longer-horizon returns, suggesting they generate minimal long-term investment value. These effects are most pronounced for tweets issued by crypto-influencers proclaiming to be crypto experts, for smaller cap crypto asset securities and for self-described experts with many Twitter followers. In an additional analysis, we use machine-learning methods to classify tweets and find that this pattern of results strengthens when the tweets have a more positive sentiment or relate to buy recommendations.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究考察加密货币影响者所提供信息的投资价值，即在Twitter上发布加密货币资产相关内容的社交媒体影响者。我们考察了180位最知名的加密货币社交媒体影响者在截至2022年12月的两年间发布的约36,000条推文所对应的收益，这些推文涉及1,600多种加密货币资产。我们的主要结果表明，加密货币影响者的推文最初与正收益相关。然而，这些推文之后伴随着显著的较长时期负收益，表明它们产生的长期投资价值极小。这些效应在以下情况下最为明显：由自称加密货币专家的加密货币影响者发布的推文、市值较小的加密货币资产证券，以及拥有众多Twitter粉丝的自称专家。在一项补充分析中，我们使用机器学习方法对推文进行分类，发现当推文具有更积极的情绪或涉及买入建议时，这一结果模式会增强。

papers.abstract_original: This paper studies a model in which investors’ information acquisition and the manager’s investment choice (hence the moments of the firm’s cash flow) are jointly determined. I show that a lower information acquisition cost alters the information environment in a way that motivates the manager to prioritize reducing the variance of cash flow over improving its mean. I present conditions under which a decrease in the cost of information acquisition reduces stock valuations and investors’ welfare. The analysis highlights the importance of considering the joint determination of firm risk in studying investors’ information acquisition. The model’s predictions are relevant to the growing literature that studies technological advancements and regulatory requirements that lower the cost for investors to acquire and process information.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个模型，其中投资者的信息获取与管理者的投资选择（进而决定公司现金流的各阶矩）是共同决定的。我表明，较低的信息获取成本会以某种方式改变信息环境，从而促使管理者优先降低现金流的方差，而非改善其均值。我给出了信息获取成本下降会降低股票估值和投资者福利的条件。该分析凸显了在研究投资者信息获取时考虑公司风险联合决定的重要性。该模型的预测与日益增多的、研究降低投资者获取和处理信息成本的技术进步与监管要求的文献相关。

papers.abstract_original: State tax revenue forecasting is critical to states’ fiscal planning because many states have constitutions or laws that require a balanced budget and restrict borrowing to fund deficits. We develop and compare four measures of aggregate corporate earnings growth. We find that a state-specific industry-weighted measure of earnings growth predicts future state tax revenue growth, incremental to states’ actual forecasts (i.e., it increases explanatory power by a factor of 1.86). Earnings growth also improves states’ component forecasts of personal income, sales, and corporate income tax revenues. We also find that both forecast errors and lagged earnings growth can explain midyear spending cuts, suggesting that there are real consequences to omitting earnings growth from tax revenue forecasts. Because accurate revenue forecasts are necessary for the efficient allocation of government resources, these findings should be useful to those who prepare, monitor, or are otherwise affected by state tax revenue forecasts and budgets.
papers.abstract_zh: 州税收收入预测对各州的财政规划至关重要，因为许多州的宪法或法律要求预算平衡，并限制为弥补赤字而借款。我们构建并比较了四种总体企业盈余增长的度量。我们发现，一种针对特定州的行业加权盈余增长度量能够预测未来州税收收入增长，且在各州实际预测之外具有增量信息（即它将解释力提高了1.86倍）。盈余增长还改善了各州对个人所得税、销售税和企业所得税收入的构成预测。我们还发现，预测误差和滞后盈余增长都能解释年中支出削减，这表明将盈余增长从税收收入预测中遗漏会产生实际后果。由于准确的收入预测是政府资源有效配置的必要条件，这些发现应当对编制、监测州税收收入预测和预算或以其他方式受其影响的人有用。

papers.abstract_original: We study how the launch of an electronically traded fund (ETF) that holds firms in a specific industry changes the behavior of analysts who follow that firms in that industry. An industry ETF allows investors to trade the firm-specific payoff separately from the industry payoff. This causes significant changes in the value of different types of information. In particular, following an increase in a firm’s industry ETF coverage, the firm’s analyst coverage increases in the following year, and this holds after controlling for changes in institutional investment and other characteristics. We also find that, following an increase in ETF coverage, analyst recommendations are more likely to include an industry recommendation separate from the firm-specific recommendation, and the latter is more likely to be stated in relative terms. Our results strengthen when the new ETF is a better hedge against the industry payoff factor and when we introduce a plausible control for endogeneity.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究一只持有特定行业公司的交易所交易基金（ETF）的推出，如何改变跟踪该行业内这些公司的分析师的行为。行业ETF使投资者能够将公司特定收益与行业收益分开交易。这导致不同类型信息的价值发生显著变化。具体而言，在一家公司的行业ETF覆盖度增加之后，该公司的分析师覆盖度在随后一年增加，并且在控制了机构投资和其他特征的变化之后，这一结果依然成立。我们还发现，在ETF覆盖度增加之后，分析师建议更有可能包含与公司特定建议相分离的行业建议，而后者更有可能以相对措辞表述。当新ETF是对行业收益因子的更好对冲时，以及当我们引入一个合理的内生性控制时，我们的结果更强。

papers.abstract_original: Bond defaults are undesirable yet natural outcomes of risky investments. What is also crucial but hitherto underexplored is the unexpectedness of defaults. We develop a parsimonious measure of default unexpectedness and highlight its economic importance by demonstrating that unexpected defaults are associated with unfavorable recovery outcomes and adverse price changes in peer firm bonds. We then examine how default unexpectedness relates to information opacity. We find that firms with opaque financial reporting and weak voluntary disclosure experience more unexpected defaults. Defaults also occur more unexpectedly when the external information environment is opaque—when rating agencies disagree on a firm’s credit risk and when the media coverage is low. We further report evidence on a specific case in which transparent firms suffer unexpected defaults—when creditors’ run incentives are particularly high. Overall, our paper introduces default unexpectedness as an economically relevant construct, offers a tractable measure, and highlights the role of transparency in mediating this phenomenon.
papers.abstract_zh: 债券违约是风险投资不受欢迎却又自然的结果。同样关键但迄今尚未得到充分探讨的是违约的意外性。我们构建了一个简洁的违约意外性度量指标，并通过证明意外违约与不利的回收结果以及同行业公司债券的不利价格变动相关，凸显了其经济重要性。随后，我们考察了违约意外性与信息不透明之间的关系。我们发现，财务报告不透明且自愿披露薄弱的企业经历更多意外违约。当外部信息环境不透明时——即当评级机构对一家企业的信用风险存在分歧以及媒体报道较少时——违约也更意外地发生。我们进一步报告了关于一个具体情形的证据，即透明企业遭遇意外违约——当债权人的挤兑激励特别高时。总体而言，本文引入了违约意外性这一具有经济相关性的构念，提供了一个易于处理的度量指标，并凸显了透明度在调节这一现象中的作用。

papers.abstract_original: Ethnic tension in the United States became more salient after Donald Trump’s election on November 9, 2016. Exploring the variation in management forecasts, we show that after the Trump election, minority CEOs exhibit more pessimism in their earnings forecasts (underestimation of the mean of earnings), compared with their non-minority counterparts. This tendency toward pessimism is observed across CEOs from various minority groups and is particularly pronounced in firms led by less experienced or less confident minority CEOs. Further analyses reveal that minority CEOs make less specific and less precise forecasts. Minority CEO pessimism is not explained by alternative explanations including terrorist attacks and minority CEOs’ political ideology. Collectively, our research provides evidence that the Trump election induces biased beliefs in the form of pessimism in ethnic minority CEOs.
papers.abstract_zh: 在唐纳德·特朗普于2016年11月9日当选之后，美国的族裔紧张关系变得更加突出。通过考察管理层预测的变异，我们表明，在特朗普当选之后，与少数族裔CEO相比，少数族裔CEO在其盈利预测中表现出更多的悲观情绪（低估盈利均值）。这种悲观倾向在来自不同少数族裔群体的CEO中均可观察到，并且在由经验较少或信心较低的少数族裔CEO领导的公司中尤为明显。进一步分析显示，少数族裔CEO做出的预测更不具体、更不精确。少数族裔CEO的悲观情绪无法由其他解释所解释，包括恐怖袭击和少数族裔CEO的政治意识形态。总体而言，我们的研究提供了证据，表明特朗普当选以悲观情绪的形式在少数族裔CEO中引发了有偏信念。

papers.abstract_original: We examine the role of private equity in alleviating earnings myopia induced by public markets. We first construct a measure of earnings myopia and show that this measure varies as predicted with determinants and effects of myopia. Then we show that public firms exhibiting earnings myopia realize an increased likelihood of takeover by private equity buyers. Cross-sectional analyses indicate that this relation is strongest when costs of earnings myopia are likely higher. Following private equity takeovers, firms exhibiting greater measures of earnings myopia realize improvements to R&D investment and productivity. The results add to the understanding of the role of private equity in identifying and alleviating earnings myopia within U.S. capital markets. This is important given the increasing size of private equity assets under management. Takeover premiums paid for myopic firms suggest a cost of earnings myopia at approximately 6.9% of firm value.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考察私募股权在缓解由公开市场引发的盈余短视方面的作用。我们首先构建了一个盈余短视的度量指标，并表明该指标随短视的决定因素和后果的变化而变化，符合预期。随后我们表明，表现出盈余短视的上市公司被私募股权买家收购的可能性增加。横截面分析表明，当盈余短视的成本可能更高时，这一关系最为显著。在私募股权收购之后，盈余短视度量指标较高的公司在研发投资和生产率方面实现了改善。这些结果增进了对私募股权在美国资本市场中识别和缓解盈余短视方面作用的理解。鉴于私募股权管理资产规模日益增大，这一点尤为重要。为短视公司支付的收购溢价表明，盈余短视的成本约为公司价值的6.9%。

papers.abstract_original: This study investigates when institutional investors seek on-site meetings with their portfolio firms and the subsequent informativeness of their trading decisions. We identify private interactions by creating and validating a novel measure based on the taxi traffic between an institutional investor’s business office and its investee’s headquarters. This measure allows a more granular unit of analysis and better control for investor-specific characteristics correlated with investors’ private access. We find institutional investors allocate efforts to meetings with portfolio firms to shape expectations and gain investment advantages through these private interactions. Investors’ trades are more informed when there are more private interactions with investee firms. Consistent with public information leveling the playing field, cross-sectional results suggest that institutional investors’ returns from private information acquisition mainly concentrate in firms with opaque information environments. Overall, this study suggests that private interactions with public firms reward institutional investors with information that improves their trading decisions.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究考察机构投资者何时寻求与其投资组合公司进行现场会面，以及其随后交易决策的信息含量。我们通过构建并验证一种基于机构投资者办公地点与其被投资公司总部之间出租车交通流量的新指标来识别私下互动。该指标允许进行更细粒度的分析，并能更好地控制与投资者私下接触渠道相关的投资者特定特征。我们发现，机构投资者会将精力分配到与投资组合公司的会面上，以塑造预期并通过这些私下互动获取投资优势。当与被投资公司存在更多私下互动时，投资者的交易更具信息含量。与公开信息能够拉平竞争环境的观点一致，横截面结果表明，机构投资者从私人信息获取中获得的回报主要集中在信息环境不透明的公司中。总体而言，本研究表明，与上市公司的私下互动为机构投资者提供了有助于改善其交易决策的信息。

papers.abstract_original: Research concludes that managers’ political orientation influences their decision-making and offers the political connections and risk tolerance hypotheses as explanations. We investigate partisan bias as an additional way political orientation may influence managers’ decisions. Partisan bias results in individuals whose partisan orientation aligns with that of the US president expressing more optimistic economic expectations. We examine whether partisan bias is present in managers’ annual earnings forecasts. We find that firms with CEOs whose partisanship aligns with that of the US president issue more optimistically biased annual earnings forecasts than firms with other CEOs. Higher-ability CEOs, however, are less susceptible to partisan bias. Additionally, we find that overestimating customer demand contributes to the forecast over-optimism of partisan-aligned CEOs and results in greater firm overinvestment. Furthermore, investors fail to discount the news in forecasts of partisan-aligned CEOs, and their firms’ post-forecast abnormal returns are lower.
papers.abstract_zh: 研究认为，管理者的政治倾向会影响其决策，并提出政治关联与风险容忍度假说来加以解释。我们将党派偏见作为政治倾向可能影响管理者决策的另一种方式加以考察。党派偏见导致那些党派倾向与美国总统一致的个体会表达更为乐观的经济预期。我们检验管理者的年度盈余预测中是否存在党派偏见。我们发现，与CEO党派倾向与其他CEO相比，那些CEO党派倾向与美国总统一致的公司会发布更为乐观偏误的年度盈余预测。然而，能力更高的CEO较不易受党派偏见影响。此外，我们发现，高估客户需求会加剧党派倾向一致CEO的预测过度乐观，并导致更大的公司过度投资。进一步而言，投资者未能对党派倾向一致CEO预测中的信息进行折价，其公司预测后的异常收益更低。

papers.abstract_original: We analyze the motivational effects of managing by walking around (MBWA), a management style that emphasizes managers’ visits to the rank and file of the company. We do so by conducting a field experiment in the retail division of a Latin American bank. We find that branches significantly increase sales productivity following the management visit, an effect that begins prior to the top manager’s visit and persists for at least a month afterward. We also find a higher impact of the visit on high-performing branches. Our results indicate that motivation is a significant channel through which MBWA improves employee performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们分析了“走动式管理”（MBWA）的激励效果，这是一种强调管理者走访公司普通员工的管理风格。我们通过在拉丁美洲一家银行的零售部门开展实地实验来进行研究。我们发现，在管理层走访之后，分支机构的销售生产率显著提高，这一效应在高层管理者走访之前就已开始，并在走访后至少持续一个月。我们还发现，走访对高绩效分支机构的影响更大。我们的结果表明，激励是MBWA提高员工绩效的一个重要渠道。

papers.abstract_original: I investigate whether auditors engage in greater monitoring of acquirers during industry merger waves. Merger waves are periods of industry transformation (i.e., disruption) that are accompanied by greater uncertainty, limited internal and external corporate monitoring, and poorer acquisition performance. These factors threaten the quality of acquirers’ financial reports. I test whether auditors respond to these periods by increasing their effort, which improves audit quality, and by resigning from high-risk engagements to reduce their portfolio risk. For in-wave audits, I find that audit fees are higher, financial statements are less likely to be materially misstated, auditors are more likely to timely identify and report internal control deficiencies, and auditor resignations are higher. Overall, these findings are consistent with auditors adapting to merger waves and providing higher-quality corporate monitoring within the scope of their influence. Importantly, this study provides insights that broaden our understanding of auditing and M&A transactions.
papers.abstract_zh: 我研究审计师是否在行业并购浪潮期间对收购方进行更多监督。并购浪潮是行业转型（即颠覆）时期，伴随着更大的不确定性、有限的内外部公司监督以及较差的收购业绩。这些因素威胁着收购方财务报告的质量。我检验审计师是否通过增加努力（从而提高审计质量）以及辞去高风险业务（以降低其业务组合风险）来应对这些时期。对于浪潮期间的审计，我发现审计费用更高，财务报表更不可能存在重大错报，审计师更可能及时识别并报告内部控制缺陷，且审计师辞职率更高。总体而言，这些发现与审计师适应并购浪潮并在其影响范围内提供更高质量的公司监督相一致。重要的是，本研究提供了拓宽我们对审计与并购交易理解的见解。

papers.abstract_original: Mutual funds regularly issue factsheets to communicate their performance in a short summary form. I investigate whether the release of factsheets in Morningstar plays a role in the trading behavior of retail investors. I find that retail investors react more to performance measures in factsheets when these are disseminated through Morningstar, and therefore made salient, than when they are not. The results cannot be explained by dissemination via alternative platforms, fund advertising, marketing by financial intermediaries, funds’ anticipation of investor reaction, or selective reporting of performance measures. Additional analysis suggests that factsheets do not help improve retail investors’ investment allocation decisions; if anything, I find some evidence consistent with overreaction to performance measures disseminated via factsheets, while mandatory fund disclosures tend to mitigate this overreaction. Taken together, these findings contribute to a more nuanced understanding of summary disclosures by highlighting the unintended consequence of investor overreaction.
papers.abstract_zh: 共同基金定期发布概况说明书，以简短摘要的形式沟通其业绩。我研究在晨星发布概况说明书是否对散户投资者的交易行为发挥作用。我发现，当业绩指标通过晨星传播、因而变得显著时，散户投资者对概况说明书中的业绩指标反应更强，而当其未通过晨星传播时则不然。这些结果无法由通过其他平台传播、基金广告、金融中介的营销、基金对投资者反应的预期或对业绩指标的选择性报告来解释。进一步分析表明，概况说明书无助于改善散户投资者的投资配置决策；如果说有什么的话，我发现一些证据与对通过概况说明书传播的业绩指标反应过度相一致，而强制性基金披露倾向于缓解这种反应过度。总体而言，这些发现通过强调投资者反应过度这一非预期后果，有助于对摘要披露形成更为细致的理解。

papers.abstract_original: We investigate whether firms that proclaim a commitment to corporate social responsibility (CSR) by CSR reporting indeed internalize such a commitment and behave more responsibly. We analyze the association of the issuance and quality of voluntary CSR reports with the occurrence, number, and severity of corporate misbehaviors, both preceding and subsequent to CSR reporting. We find a significantly positive association of CSR reporting with our measures of prior and future misbehavior. The results are corroborated by a quasi-natural experiment around the Rana Plaza disaster where we find that the signatories of an accord for better working conditions have significantly higher prior and future misbehavior relative to non-signatories and firms unaffected by the exogenous shock. Our results are in line with legitimacy theory implying that, on average, the firms’ proclaiming commitment to CSR is not a signal of internalized commitment but more likely serves greenwashing and impression management purposes.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考察那些通过发布企业社会责任（CSR）报告宣称致力于企业社会责任的公司是否真的将这种承诺内化，并表现得更加负责任。我们分析了自愿性CSR报告的发布与质量同企业不当行为的发生、数量及严重程度之间的关联，涵盖CSR报告之前与之后两个时期。我们发现，CSR报告与我们对先前及未来不当行为的衡量指标之间存在显著正相关关系。围绕拉纳广场（Rana Plaza）灾难的一项准自然实验佐证了这些结果：我们发现，相较于非签署方以及未受该外生冲击影响的公司，一项旨在改善工作条件的协议的签署方在先前及未来均有显著更高的不当行为。我们的结果与合法性理论相一致，表明平均而言，公司宣称对企业社会责任的承诺并非内化承诺的信号，而更可能服务于漂绿和印象管理目的。

papers.abstract_original: This paper investigates if the Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB) and the International Accounting Standards Board (IASB) convergence project changed the underlying natures of both sets of accounting standards. Using the rules-based continuum score and a new principles-based continuum score, we find that before convergence, US Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (US GAAP) contained more rules-based standards, while International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) contained more principles-based standards. After the convergence project, US GAAP became relatively more principles-based, while IFRS became relatively more rules-based, consistent with both standard-setters compromising in their approaches to standard setting in order to facilitate convergence. Overall, our results suggest that the convergence project achieved its goal of improving alignment between US GAAP and IFRS. However, it appears to have had a possibly unintended consequence of making IFRS contain more rules-based characteristics.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文考察了财务会计准则委员会（FASB）与国际会计准则理事会（IASB）的趋同项目是否改变了两套会计准则的基本性质。我们使用规则导向连续体得分和一项新的原则导向连续体得分，发现趋同之前，美国公认会计原则（US GAAP）包含更多规则导向的准则，而国际财务报告准则（IFRS）包含更多原则导向的准则。趋同项目之后，US GAAP变得相对更原则导向，而IFRS变得相对更规则导向，这与两个准则制定者在准则制定方法上做出妥协以促进趋同相一致。总体而言，我们的结果表明，趋同项目实现了改善US GAAP与IFRS之间一致性的目标。然而，它似乎产生了一个可能并非有意的后果，即让IFRS包含更多规则导向的特征。

papers.abstract_original: We use COVID-19 and sell-side analysts as an experiment to study the effects of gender on labor productivity. We find that the forecast accuracy of female analysts declined more than that of male analysts, especially when schools were closed and among analysts who were more likely to have young children, were inexperienced, were busier, or lived in southern states of the US. Relative to male analysts, females also reduced their forecast timeliness and resorted to more heuristic forecasts but did not reduce coverage or updating frequency. Relative to pre pandemic, female analysts’ careers were more negatively affected than male analysts’. Overall, our results show that the pandemic impacted female analysts more than males through the quality of their forecasts but not the quantity.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们以COVID-19和卖方分析师作为实验，研究性别对劳动生产率的影响。我们发现，女性分析师的预测准确度下降幅度大于男性分析师，尤其是在学校关闭时，以及在更有可能有年幼子女、经验不足、工作更繁忙或居住在美国南部各州的分析师中。相对于男性分析师，女性还降低了预测的及时性，并更多地采用启发式预测，但并未减少覆盖范围或更新频率。相对于疫情前，女性分析师的职业生涯受到的负面影响大于男性分析师。总体而言，我们的结果表明，疫情通过预测质量而非预测数量对女性分析师的影响大于男性。

papers.abstract_original: We identify a novel force behind the benefit of misaligned preferences in corporate governance. Our model entails a CEO who encounters a project and, after gathering information, decides whether to seek the approval of a corporate board. The CEO may be able to choose the properties of the collected information—this may happen if the project is “novel,” i.e., explores a new technology, business concept, or market and directors are less knowledgeable about it. We find that only sufficiently conservative and expansion-cautious directors can discipline the CEO’s empire-building tendency and opportunistic information collection. Such directors, however, underinvest in projects that are not novel. The board that maximizes firm value is either conservative or neutral (has interests aligned with the shareholders) and always overinvests in innovations. Boards with greater expertise are more likely to be conservative, but their bias is less severe. The board’s commitment power and bias are substitutes.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们识别出公司治理中偏好不一致带来益处背后的一种新力量。我们的模型设定一位CEO遇到一个项目，并在收集信息后决定是否寻求公司董事会的批准。CEO或许能够选择所收集信息的属性——如果项目是“新颖的”，即探索新技术、新商业概念或新市场，而董事对此了解较少，这种情况就可能发生。我们发现，只有足够保守且对扩张持谨慎态度的董事才能约束CEO的帝国构建倾向和机会主义的信息收集。然而，这类董事会对非新颖项目投资不足。使公司价值最大化的董事会要么是保守的，要么是中立的（利益与股东一致），并且总是对创新过度投资。拥有更强专业知识的董事会更可能是保守的，但其偏见程度较轻。董事会的承诺能力与偏见互为替代。

papers.abstract_original: We offer two new fraud prediction metrics: the AB-score, which is based on Benford’s Law, and the ABF-score, which combines the AB-score with the well-known F-score model from the seminal work by Dechow et al. ( 2011 ). Multiple performance evaluation metrics show that the ABF-score provides the highest accuracy, while the AB-score substantially expands the scope over which misreporting can be predicted. Additionally, both models are easier to estimate than other popular models while delivering similar accuracy. Our models perform well in- and out-of-sample and across alternative misstatement proxies. Back-of-the-envelope calculations suggest that our improved precision (over the F-score model) could save stakeholders about $14.34 billion (in 2016 dollars) annually. Finally, in a case study approach using a sample of notorious financial frauds, we show that our models offer sharper identification of fraud with an expanded scope that correctly identifies far more fraudulent firm-years.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提出了两个新的欺诈预测指标：基于本福德定律的AB-score，以及将AB-score与Dechow等人（2011）开创性研究中著名的F-score模型相结合的ABF-score。多种绩效评估指标显示，ABF-score提供了最高的准确性，而AB-score则大幅扩展了可预测错报的范围。此外，这两个模型在提供相似准确性的同时，比其他流行模型更易于估计。我们的模型在样本内和样本外以及在不同错报代理变量下均表现良好。粗略估算表明，我们（相对于F-score模型）提升的精确度每年可为利益相关者节省约143.4亿美元（按2016年美元计）。最后，在一项使用臭名昭著的财务欺诈样本的案例研究中，我们表明我们的模型能够更精准地识别欺诈，且范围更广，能够正确识别出多得多的欺诈性公司-年度。

papers.abstract_original: We develop a rating system to evaluate the quality of individual non-GAAP exclusions. Our perspective is that high-quality exclusions reflect nonrecurring economic transactions, are transitory accounting adjustments, or have little usefulness in forecasting cash flows. We use four approaches to rate exclusions. We evaluate the serial correlation of the exclusion, survey accounting academics’ views, obtain practitioner ratings from the CFA Institute, and identify the exclusions approved by the Chinese securities regulator. A firm’s exclusion quality score is the weighted average rating of its individual exclusions. For our sample of S&P 500 firms, we document that exclusion quality varies by industry, captures trends in non-GAAP reporting, and is reasonably stable at the firm level. To validate the rating, we show that firms with lower exclusion quality scores receive more SEC comment letters, incur more Regulation G violations, exhibit greater analyst forecast dispersion, and have slower price discovery following earnings announcements.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们开发了一套评级体系，用以评估个别非GAAP调整项目的质量。我们的观点是，高质量的调整项目反映的是非经常性经济交易，属于暂时性会计调整，或者对预测现金流几乎没有用处。我们采用四种方法对调整项目进行评级。我们评估调整项目的序列相关性，调查会计学者的观点，获取CFA协会的从业者评级，并识别中国证券监管机构认可的调整项目。一家公司的调整项目质量得分是其各个调整项目评级的加权平均值。对于我们的标普500公司样本，我们记录到调整项目质量因行业而异，反映了非GAAP报告的趋势，并且在公司层面相当稳定。为验证该评级，我们表明，调整项目质量得分较低的公司收到更多SEC意见函，发生更多违反G条例的情况，表现出更大的分析师预测分歧，并且在收益公告后价格发现更慢。

papers.abstract_original: We provide the first large-sample evidence on third-party verification of firms’ environmental and social metrics in ESG reports (ESG assurance) in the United States. Focusing on the S&P 500 from 2010–2020, we document a striking increase in not only the number of firms with ESG assurance—in 2020 (2010), 76% (38%) of the S&P 500 had an ESG report and 46% (16%) involved assurance—but also the number of metrics assured. Unlike financial audits, ESG assurance varies widely in form and substance, including the choice of metrics assured, the level of assurance, and assuror identity. We show that firms’ decision to obtain ESG assurance is primarily driven by their adoption of ESG reporting frameworks and peer effects, with firm characteristics documented in prior literature playing only a minor role. Assurance is associated with improvements in ESG disclosure, ESG ratings, and the number of institutional investors holding the firm’s stock.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们提供了关于美国公司ESG报告中环境和社会指标第三方验证（ESG鉴证）的首个大样本证据。以2010年至2020年的标普500指数公司为研究对象，我们记录了不仅拥有ESG鉴证的公司数量显著增加——2020年（2010年）标普500指数中有76%（38%）的公司发布了ESG报告，其中46%（16%）涉及鉴证——而且被鉴证的指标数量也显著增加。与财务审计不同，ESG鉴证在形式和实质上差异很大，包括所鉴证指标的选择、鉴证水平以及鉴证机构身份。我们表明，公司获取ESG鉴证的决策主要受其采用ESG报告框架和同行效应驱动，而先前文献中记录的公司特征仅起次要作用。鉴证与ESG披露、ESG评级以及持有该公司股票的机构投资者数量的改善相关。

papers.abstract_original: A few highly successful firms (“superstar firms”) have captured large market shares and earned massive profits in recent decades. We examine whether superstar firms are associated with a greater likelihood of financial distress for firms exposed to them in product markets. Building on recent research, we identify superstars as firms with the highest markups in the industry and whose industry markup share increases over time. We then measure, with product similarity scores, a firm’s overall product market exposure to superstars. We document that firms with greater exposure are more likely to file for bankruptcy. We examine why superstar exposure is associated with bankruptcy and show that firms with the greater superstar exposure exhibit weaker financial performance and greater riskiness. Furthermore, we show that the association between superstar exposure and the likelihood of bankruptcy strengthens when superstars have greater market power.
papers.abstract_zh: 近几十年来，少数极为成功的企业（“超级明星企业”）占据了很大的市场份额并赚取了巨额利润。我们考察超级明星企业是否与在产品市场上对其存在敞口的企业更可能陷入财务困境相关。基于近期研究，我们将超级明星企业界定为行业内加成率最高的企业，且其行业加成率份额随时间上升。随后，我们使用产品相似度评分来衡量一家企业对超级明星企业的总体产品市场敞口。我们记录到，敞口更大的企业更可能申请破产。我们考察为何超级明星敞口与破产相关，并表明超级明星敞口更大的企业表现出更弱的财务业绩和更高的风险性。此外，我们表明，当超级明星企业拥有更大的市场势力时，超级明星敞口与破产可能性之间的关联会增强。

papers.abstract_original: This paper documents the difference in asymmetric labor adjustment between male and female employees, as alluded to in the labor economics literature. Based on detailed gender-specific employment disclosures of Korean-listed firms, we report a significant presence of labor cost stickiness. Breaking labor costs down, we further show that labor cost stickiness is mainly attributable to the asymmetric adjustment of employment rather than that of wages. More importantly, this adjustment is more salient for males than it is for females, suggesting that managers tend to dismiss females to a greater extent than males during sales downturns than they recruit during sales upturns. In cross-sectional analyses, we present evidence that formal and informal institutions underlie the asymmetric labor adjustment. Lastly, gender differences in asymmetric labor adjustment widen the tenure gap across gender, which may contribute to the low likelihood of firms appointing and promoting female executives.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文记录了男性与女性员工之间非对称劳动调整的差异，正如劳动经济学文献所暗示的那样。基于韩国上市公司详细的按性别披露的雇佣信息，我们报告了劳动力成本粘性的显著存在。进一步将劳动力成本分解后，我们表明劳动力成本粘性主要归因于雇佣的非对称调整，而非工资的非对称调整。更重要的是，这种调整在男性中比在女性中更为显著，这表明在销售下滑期间，管理者解雇女性的程度大于解雇男性，而在销售上升期间招聘女性的程度却不及招聘男性。在横截面分析中，我们提供了证据表明正式制度和非正式制度是非对称劳动调整的基础。最后，非对称劳动调整中的性别差异扩大了性别之间的任期差距，这可能有助于解释企业任命和晋升女性高管可能性较低的现象。

papers.abstract_original: Pre-IPO firms may “test the waters” by meeting privately with investors in order to allow access to management and more time to make an investment decision. However, these meetings have the potential to undermine the SEC’s objectives of protecting investors and supporting market efficiency by allowing institutional investors, but not retail investors, private access to management. We find lower retail trading after IPOs of firms that held testing-the-waters meetings, consistent with the meetings reducing retail investor participation. Moreover, retail investors that still participate in the market in the presence of testing-the-waters meetings have inferior investment outcomes. Nonetheless, we find no evidence of lower overall market liquidity or slower price discovery following testing-the-waters meetings. In fact, we observe a reduction in stock return volatility. Overall our evidence suggests that, while testing-the-waters meetings may harm retail investors, there does not appear to be a negative impact on overall market function.
papers.abstract_zh: 首次公开募股前的公司可能通过与投资者私下会面来“试探市场”，以便让投资者接触管理层并有更多时间做出投资决策。然而，这些会议有可能让机构投资者而非散户投资者私下接触管理层，从而削弱美国证券交易委员会保护投资者和支持市场效率的目标。我们发现，在举行试探性会议的公司进行首次公开募股后，散户交易量较低，这与会议减少散户投资者参与度的结论一致。此外，在存在试探性会议的情况下仍参与市场的散户投资者，其投资结果较差。尽管如此，我们未发现证据表明试探性会议之后整体市场流动性降低或价格发现速度放缓。事实上，我们观察到股票收益波动率有所下降。总体而言，我们的证据表明，尽管试探性会议可能损害散户投资者，但似乎并未对整体市场功能产生负面影响。

papers.abstract_original: We examine the anticipatory effect triggered by the issuance of the lease exposure draft, which proposed capitalizing most operating leases, on the cost of debt of firms that rely heavily on operating leases. Employing a difference-in-differences design, we find a significant increase in loan spreads for firms with higher operating lease intensity after the issuance of the exposure draft, notably, even before the issuance of ASC 842. We explore potential channels through which this anticipatory effect occurs and find evidence supporting a perceived default risk channel and a Hirshleifer effect channel. We further investigate the real effects of the exposure draft, finding both an operating lease substitution effect and a decrease in investments. Our results highlight the importance of the anticipatory effects of accounting standards.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考察租赁征求意见稿发布所引发的预期效应，该征求意见稿提议将大多数经营租赁资本化，我们研究其对严重依赖经营租赁的公司的债务成本的影响。采用双重差分设计，我们发现，在征求意见稿发布之后，经营租赁强度较高的公司的贷款利差显著上升，值得注意的是，甚至在ASC 842发布之前就已如此。我们探究了这一预期效应发生的潜在渠道，并发现了支持感知违约风险渠道和Hirshleifer效应渠道的证据。我们进一步研究了该征求意见稿的实际效应，发现既存在经营租赁替代效应，也存在投资减少。我们的结果凸显了会计准则预期效应的重要性。

papers.abstract_original: This study documents that Chinese non-state-owned enterprises have effective tax rates that are 1% lower during the tenure of corrupt regional tax bureau commissioners (i.e., regional tax bureau chiefs). The reduction in the effective tax rate persists even after controlling for political connections of firms, general local corruption, and a variety of other determinants of tax avoidance. Further analysis shows that corrupt tax commissioners induce bribery activities and exacerbate tax avoidance, and firms in a region overseen by a corrupt tax commissioner are more likely to engage in tax haven operations and tax evasion activities as tax aggressive strategies. However, the influence of corrupt tax commissioners is moderated by a stronger regional legal system and a better information environment. Overall, our results highlight the significant impact of individual tax administrators on corporate tax avoidance behavior.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究表明，在腐败的地区税务局局长（即地区税务局局长）任职期间，中国非国有企业的有效税率低1%。即使在控制了企业的政治关联、地方总体腐败以及多种其他避税决定因素之后，有效税率的下降依然存在。进一步分析表明，腐败的税务局局长会诱发贿赂活动并加剧避税，而且税务局局长腐败所辖地区的企业更有可能实施避税天堂运营和逃税活动，作为激进税务策略。然而，腐败税务局局长的影响会受到更强的地区法律体系和更好的信息环境的调节。总体而言，我们的结果凸显了个体税务管理者对企业避税行为的显著影响。

papers.abstract_original: In recent decades, increasing globalization and rapid technological development have caused many stock exchanges to change their ownership structure from mutually owned (broker/dealer-owned) to demutualized (for-profit, shareholder-owned). This study investigates whether increased for-profit focus weakens exchanges’ monitoring incentives. Using multiple financial reporting quality metrics to capture monitoring efforts, we find that monitoring of listed firms declines post demutualization. Additional tests confirm that our findings are attributable to changes in oversight of the firms listed on demutualized exchanges (either by the exchange or the local regulator). These findings only hold among weak regulatory regimes, emphasizing the significance of strong, independent, country-level regulatory organizations in monitoring stock exchanges.
papers.abstract_zh: 近几十年来，日益加剧的全球化和快速的技术发展促使许多证券交易所将其所有权结构从互助所有（经纪商/交易商所有）转变为非互助化（营利性、股东所有）。本研究考察营利性导向的增强是否削弱了交易所的监督激励。我们使用多种财务报告质量指标来衡量监督努力，发现非互助化后对上市公司的监督有所下降。额外的检验证实，我们的发现可归因于对在非互助化交易所上市公司的监管（由交易所或当地监管机构实施）发生了变化。这些发现仅在监管制度薄弱的情况下成立，凸显了强有力的、独立的国家层面监管组织在监督证券交易所方面的重要性。

papers.abstract_original: How important is equal access to mandatory disclosures? We exploit the postal strike of 1970 that caused a delay in the delivery of annual reports via mail. This strike created unequal access because certain investors (e.g., institutions) had both the incentives and ability to obtain the annual reports by other means. Theory predicts that, when differential access exists, adverse selection problems intensify, causing a decline in stock trading. Our findings support this prediction: stock trading volume decreased by approximately 28% for firms unable to deliver the annual reports to shareholders during the strike, and this trading decline gradually dissipated afterward. Further tests confirm adverse selection as the primary mechanism. Overall, our paper underscores the importance of equal access to annual reports—a key mandated disclosure—and demonstrates the value of these reports to shareholders, as evidenced by their reluctance to trade absent this information.
papers.abstract_zh: 平等获取强制披露信息有多重要？我们利用1970年的邮政罢工这一事件，该罢工导致年度报告通过邮件递送出现延迟。这次罢工造成了不平等的获取渠道，因为某些投资者（例如机构投资者）既有动机也有能力通过其他方式获得年度报告。理论预测，当存在差异化获取渠道时，逆向选择问题会加剧，从而导致股票交易下降。我们的发现支持这一预测：在罢工期间无法向股东递送年度报告的公司，其股票交易量下降了约28%，而这种交易下降随后逐渐消散。进一步的检验证实逆向选择是主要机制。总体而言，我们的论文强调了平等获取年度报告——一项关键的强制披露——的重要性，并证明了这些报告对股东的价值，其证据是股东在缺乏这一信息时不愿进行交易。

papers.abstract_original: We make a collective assessment of the consequences of 110 auditor reputation-damaging events with media coverage (“negative events”) from 2007 to 2019 for the U.S. Big Four. First, we fail to find systematic evidence that investors react negatively to negative events. Second, while auditors experience statistically significant client loss after negative events, the effects are short-lived and economically negligible. Furthermore, we find statistically greater effects in situations where theory suggests economic forces could magnify reputation effects (i.e., higher market competition, more replacement auditors, lower client switching costs, and higher audit office reputational capital). However, the economic impact remains small in all cross sections. Overall, our results suggest that negative events with media coverage have only a very marginal impact on investors’ perceptions of Big Four firms’ audit quality and the ability of these firms to attract and retain clients.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们对2007年至2019年间110起有媒体报道的审计师声誉受损事件（“负面事件”）对美国四大会计师事务所的影响进行了总体评估。第一，我们未能发现系统性证据表明投资者会对负面事件作出负面反应。第二，尽管审计师在负面事件后经历了统计上显著的客户流失，但这些影响是短暂的，且在经济上可忽略不计。此外，我们发现在理论表明经济力量可能放大声誉效应的情况下（即更高的市场竞争、更多的替换审计师、更低的客户转换成本以及更高的审计分所声誉资本），影响在统计上更大。然而，在所有横截面中，经济影响仍然很小。总体而言，我们的结果表明，有媒体报道的负面事件对投资者关于四大会计师事务所审计质量的看法以及这些事务所吸引和留住客户的能力仅具有非常边际的影响。

papers.abstract_original: This study examines how government procurement impacts firms’ environmental disclosures and whether they have tangible effects. Using a triple-difference research design that exploits the exogenous increase in federal funding allocations to counties based on population census revisions, we find that firms with high exposure to government contracts significantly increase climate disclosure following expanded procurement opportunities. We also document that enhanced disclosure is characterized by a positive tone that emphasizes firms’ green investment and commitment to climate adaptation. The effect is more pronounced in counties with a greater increase in procurement volume and when firms have lower ex ante sustainability performance. Finally, we find firms that increase climate disclosure are more likely to earn government contracts, and they undertake real actions by reducing toxic emissions and enhancing the development of green products. Overall our results suggest government procurement promotes corporate climate responsibility by incentivizing firms to undertake climate mitigation actions.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究考察政府采购如何影响企业的环境信息披露，以及这些披露是否产生实质性影响。我们采用三重差分研究设计，利用基于人口普查修订而导致的联邦资金向各县分配的外生增加，发现对政府合同敞口较高的企业在采购机会扩大后显著增加了气候信息披露。我们还记录到，增强的披露具有积极语调的特征，强调企业的绿色投资和对气候适应的承诺。这一效应在采购量增幅较大的县以及企业事前可持续性表现较低时更为明显。最后，我们发现增加气候信息披露的企业更有可能获得政府合同，并且它们通过减少有毒排放和促进绿色产品开发采取实际行动。总体而言，我们的结果表明，政府采购通过激励企业采取气候减缓行动来促进企业气候责任。

papers.abstract_original: Insurers can boost their earnings by accruing interest income from their corporate bond investments. We document that insurers have higher corporate bond investments as well as less equity and cash holdings, when their parents meet or just beat analysts’ quarterly earnings forecasts, compared to when their parents miss or comfortably beat the forecasts. The investment in corporate bonds to boost earnings is more pronounced when bond offerings provide more opportunities for accruing interest income, when the parent’s corporate governance is weaker, when the parent’s managers have more equity incentives, when insurers face more competition, when other earnings management techniques are used, or when the insurance segment is more important to the parent. Finally, insurers suspected of helping their parents meet or beat earnings benchmarks experience worse investment performance in subsequent years, presumably because, by investing more in corporate bonds, the insurers forgo investment opportunities with higher longer-term returns.
papers.abstract_zh: 保险公司可以通过其公司债券投资计提利息收入来提升盈利。我们记录到，当母公司达到或恰好超过分析师的季度盈利预测时，与母公司未达到或轻松超过预测时相比，保险公司持有更多的公司债券投资以及更少的股权和现金持有。当债券发行提供更多计提利息收入的机会、母公司的公司治理较弱、母公司管理层拥有更多股权激励、保险公司面临更激烈的竞争、使用了其他盈余管理技术，或保险业务板块对母公司更为重要时，为提升盈利而投资于公司债券的行为更为明显。最后，被怀疑帮助母公司达到或超过盈利基准的保险公司，在随后几年中投资表现更差，这大概是因为通过更多地投资于公司债券，这些保险公司放弃了具有更高长期回报的投资机会。

papers.abstract_original: This paper investigates the effects of a regulatory change in China of the presentation format for research and development (R&D) expense, which mandates public firms to explicitly present R&D expense on their income statements. We predict that this regulation will impact nonstate-owned enterprises (non-SOEs), which care about stock market valuation, more than state-owned enterprises (SOEs). We find that non-SOEs report significantly higher R&D expense post regulation. Furthermore, the R&D increase strengthens for firms facing higher peer pressure to pursue R&D and high-tech firms and weakens for firms with higher institutional investment. The positive valuation implication of R&D diminishes post regulation, suggesting that investors discount the increase in R&D expense. An additional analysis shows that firms’ innovation efficiency decreases post regulation.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文研究中国研发（R&D）费用列报格式的监管变化所产生的影响，该变化要求上市公司在利润表中明确列报研发费用。我们预测，这一规定对关心股票市场估值的非国有企业（非国企）的影响将大于对国有企业（国企）的影响。我们发现，非国企在监管规定实施后报告的研发费用显著更高。此外，对于面临更高同行压力去从事研发的企业以及高科技企业，研发费用的增加更为明显；而对于机构投资水平较高的企业，这一增加则较弱。研发的正面估值含义在监管规定实施后减弱，表明投资者对研发费用的增加给予了折价。一项补充分析显示，企业的创新效率在监管规定实施后下降。

papers.abstract_original: The choice between historical cost and fair value measurement is one of the most debated issues among accounting academics and practitioners. We use the election of the fair value option (FVO) to study the effects of entities’ measurement choices on accounting comparability. The FVO enables entities to use different measurement bases for similar assets and liabilities, raising questions about whether the FVO compromises or enhances comparability. Using a sample of US banks, we find that FVO elections increase comparability both across FVO electing banks and between FVO electing banks and banks that never elect the FVO but only if the FVO elections comply with the intent of the standard setters to remedy accounting mismatches. Overall our results suggest that banks elect the FVO to better present their economics, yielding higher comparability.
papers.abstract_zh: 历史成本计量与公允价值计量之间的选择是会计学术界和实务界争论最激烈的问题之一。我们利用公允价值选择权（FVO）的选用，研究主体计量选择对会计可比性的影响。FVO使主体能够对类似资产和负债采用不同的计量基础，这引发了关于FVO是损害还是增强可比性的疑问。以美国银行为样本，我们发现，FVO的选用提高了可比性，既体现在选用FVO的银行之间，也体现在选用FVO的银行与从未选用FVO的银行之间，但前提是FVO的选用符合准则制定者纠正会计错配的意图。总体而言，我们的结果表明，银行选用FVO是为了更好地呈现其经济实质，从而带来更高的可比性。

papers.abstract_original: We examine the association between CEO birthplace proximity and financial misconduct. We find that CEOs managing firms near their birthplaces (home CEOs) are associated with less financial misconduct compared to other CEOs. This association is not attributable to differences in corporate governance. The relationship strengthens in areas with a strong local investment presence and greater religious commitment as well as among CEOs with longer tenures in their home state. Our findings are robust to addressing potential selection and omitted variable biases as well as to conducting multiple robustness tests, including analyses of involuntary CEO changes and headquarters relocations. We also find a similar association for CFOs, with firms employing home CFOs exhibiting less financial misconduct.

papers.abstract_original: We use a long time-series from Australia to shed light on economic factors that led to audit market concentration and the Big N. We show that increases in the size of a small number of public companies was an important factor that led to large audit firms and market concentration. We also show that emerging Big N firms made sunk cost investments, including in the ability to provide industry expertise and non-audit services, which allowed them to retain clients, differentiate, and grow. These changes occurred around the time the profession lifted restrictions on advertising, which helped facilitate differentiation, and that larger, more complex clients switched to emerging Big N firms while smaller clients switched to non-Big N firms. We do not find that increases in audit market concentration reduced competition; our results instead suggest the audit market became more competitive over time.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们利用来自澳大利亚的长时间序列数据，揭示导致审计市场集中和大型会计师事务所（Big N）形成的经济因素。我们发现，少数上市公司规模的扩大是导致大型会计师事务所出现和市场集中的重要因素。我们还发现，新兴的Big N事务所进行了沉没成本投资，包括投资于提供行业专长和非审计服务的能力，这使它们能够留住客户、实现差异化并实现增长。这些变化发生在该行业取消广告限制的时期前后，而广告限制的取消有助于促进差异化；同时，规模更大、更复杂的客户转向新兴的Big N事务所，而规模较小的客户则转向非Big N事务所。我们并未发现审计市场集中度的提高降低了竞争；相反，我们的结果表明，审计市场随时间推移变得更具竞争性。

papers.abstract_original: We conjecture that a greater opportunity for audit partners to share personal industry knowledge with each other within audit offices is associated with higher audit quality. Using Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (PCAOB) Form AP data, we analyze each partner’s client portfolio and construct sharing measures. First, we find extant measures of an audit office’s industry market share, industry portfolio share, and industry diversity are quite noisy in inferring our sharing measures. Next, we perform multivariate analyses and find negative associations between the opportunity to share industry knowledge and both restatements and absolute abnormal accruals. Further, we find this association varies cross-sectionally with other important auditor and client characteristics. Taken together, our evidence is consistent with a positive association between the opportunity for partners to share their industry knowledge with each other and audit quality.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们推测，审计合伙人之间在审计事务所内相互分享个人行业知识的机会越大，审计质量就越高。利用美国公众公司会计监督委员会（PCAOB）的AP表数据，我们分析了每位合伙人的客户组合，并构建了共享度量指标。首先，我们发现，现有用于推断我们共享度量指标的审计事务所行业市场份额、行业组合份额和行业多样性度量指标存在相当大的噪声。接下来，我们进行了多变量分析，发现行业知识共享机会与财务报表重述和绝对异常应计项之间均存在负相关关系。此外，我们发现这种关联会随其他重要的审计师和客户特征而发生横截面变化。总体而言，我们的证据与合伙人之间相互分享行业知识的机会和审计质量之间存在正相关关系这一结论相一致。

papers.abstract_original: This paper investigates how competition for scarce corporate resources impacts innovation incentives within multidivisional firms and, consequently, shapes firms’ preferences for fostering or restricting intra-firm competition. In our model, divisions become privately informed about the potential value of new investment opportunities generated through their innovation initiatives. We demonstrate that intra-firm competition unambiguously reduces divisions’ ex ante innovation incentives. However, it benefits ex post resource allocation by enabling the firm to (i) select the most promising project and (ii) limit the rents divisions earn from their private information. Consequently, a firm’s preference to limit or encourage interdivisional competition hinges on balancing ex post allocative efficiency, which favors increased intra-firm competition, against ex ante innovation incentives, which favor reduced competition. Our analysis identifies plausible conditions under which each organizational design—competitive or exclusive innovation—emerges as the optimal choice.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文研究对稀缺公司资源的竞争如何影响多部门企业内部的创新激励，并进而塑造企业促进或限制企业内部竞争的偏好。在我们的模型中，各部门会私下获知通过其创新举措所产生的新投资机会的潜在价值。我们证明，企业内部竞争明确无误地降低了各部门的事前创新激励。然而，它通过使企业能够(i)选择最有前景的项目以及(ii)限制各部门从其私人信息中获取的租金，从而有利于事后的资源配置。因此，企业限制或鼓励部门间竞争的偏好取决于在事后配置效率（其倾向于增加企业内部竞争）与事前创新激励（其倾向于减少竞争）之间进行权衡。我们的分析识别出每种组织设计——竞争性创新或排他性创新——成为最优选择的合理条件。

papers.abstract_original: This study examines whether the revised lease standards (ASC 842 and IFRS 16) make U.S. GAAP-based accounting amounts more comparable with IFRS-based accounting amounts. Our study is motivated by the FASB and the IASB’s call for research on the comparability of the revised lease standards. We find that U.S. GAAP and IFRS pairs that are high operating lease users experience a larger increase in accounting comparability after the adoption of revised lease standards than low operating lease U.S. GAAP-IFRS pairs. Additionally, our results suggest that the improvement comes more from the changes to the balance sheet rather than the income statement and is more pronounced for IFRS firms from countries with stronger accounting enforcement. Lastly, we show that analysts who are more GAAP-focused (IFRS-focused) prior to the standard change are more likely to increase their forecasting of book value per share for IFRS (U.S. GAAP) firms.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究考察修订后的租赁准则（ASC 842和IFRS 16）是否使基于美国GAAP的会计金额与基于IFRS的会计金额更具可比性。我们的研究受到FASB和IASB呼吁对修订后租赁准则的可比性进行研究的启发。我们发现，与低经营租赁使用的美国GAAP-IFRS配对相比，高经营租赁使用的美国GAAP与IFRS配对在采用修订后的租赁准则后，会计可比性的提升幅度更大。此外，我们的结果表明，这一改善更多来自资产负债表的变化，而非利润表的变化，并且在来自会计执行力度较强国家的IFRS公司中更为明显。最后，我们表明，在准则变更前更关注GAAP（更关注IFRS）的分析师，更有可能增加对IFRS（美国GAAP）公司每股账面价值的预测。

papers.abstract_original: We examine whether mutual fund managers overestimate carbon risk when they are exposed to local air pollution. We find that air pollution near fund managers induces them to underweight stocks of high-emission firms. The effects strengthen among environmentally conscious fund managers and among those likely to be surprised by air pollution—consistent with the idea that managers revise their beliefs about carbon risk following exposure to air pollution. A firm’s carbon-emissions disclosures and fund managers’ sophistication moderate these effects. Carbon-intensive stocks sold by fund managers who are exposed to local air pollution subsequently outperform stocks they buy, suggesting that such underweighting is costly to fund investors.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考察当共同基金经理暴露于当地空气污染时，他们是否会高估碳风险。我们发现，基金经理附近的空气污染会促使他们低配高排放企业的股票。这种效应在具有环保意识的基金经理以及那些可能对空气污染感到意外的基金经理中更强——这与基金经理在暴露于空气污染后修正其对碳风险的信念这一观点一致。企业的碳排放披露和基金经理的老练程度会调节这些效应。由暴露于当地空气污染的基金经理卖出的碳密集型股票随后表现优于他们买入的股票，这表明这种低配对基金投资者而言代价高昂。

papers.abstract_original: We study the extent to which creditors shape the executive bonus plans of their financially distressed borrowers. Financial distress can exacerbate agency conflicts between creditors and borrowers as concerns with underinvestment become more acute due to managerial myopia and debt overhang. Consequently, we expect creditors to exert their influence to ensure that these managers’ incentive-compensation plans encourage longer-term investments and directly reward outcomes that benefit creditors without exposing managers to unnecessary risk. We argue that bonus plans are an especially important way to provide these incentives because their flexibility allows creditors to more precisely target specific investment objectives. We find that borrowers’ bonus plans tend to have longer horizons and more convex payouts following covenant violations, especially when bonus plans can be a particularly effective way to address distress-related agency conflicts. Our evidence suggests that creditors protect their interests by exercising their control rights to shape their borrowers’ incentive-compensation plans.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究债权人在多大程度上塑造其财务困境借款方的高管奖金计划。财务困境可能加剧债权人与借款方之间的代理冲突，因为管理层的短视和债务积压会使投资不足的担忧变得更加尖锐。因此，我们预期债权人会施加其影响力，以确保这些管理者的激励性薪酬计划鼓励更长期的投资，并直接奖励有利于债权人的结果，同时不让管理者承担不必要的风险。我们认为，奖金计划是提供这些激励的一种尤为重要方式，因为其灵活性使债权人能够更精准地针对特定投资目标。我们发现，在违反契约条款之后，借款方的奖金计划往往具有更长的期限和更凸性的支付，尤其是在奖金计划可以成为解决与困境相关的代理冲突的特别有效方式时。我们的证据表明，债权人通过行使控制权来塑造借款方的激励性薪酬计划，从而保护自身利益。

papers.abstract_original: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) mandates disclosure of Article 11 pro forma financial statements (pro formas) for acquisitions that exceed one of three bright-line materiality thresholds. Motivated by two theories of mandated disclosure, I investigate the conditions under which mandated pro forma disclosure improves forecast accuracy and mitigates incentive alignment problems. My findings indicate that pro formas reduce post-acquisition forecast errors when there is a weak pre-acquisition information environment. The reduction in forecast errors is larger when pro formas contain more income statement disaggregation and footnote disclosure. Using announcement returns, deal failure, and future profitability to measure acquisition quality, I find that pro formas mitigate an incentive alignment problem by increasing transparency. The forecasting and incentive alignment benefits concentrate in the same subsamples, suggesting that pro formas are more likely to mitigate an incentive alignment problem when they help forecast earnings.
papers.abstract_zh: 美国证券交易委员会（SEC）规定，对于超过三项明确重要性门槛之一的收购，必须披露第11条备考财务报表（备考报表）。基于两种强制性披露理论，我研究了强制性备考披露在何种条件下能够提高预测准确性并缓解激励一致性问题。我的研究结果表明，当收购前信息环境薄弱时，备考报表能够减少收购后的预测误差。当备考报表包含更多利润表分解信息和附注披露时，预测误差的减少幅度更大。使用公告回报、交易失败和未来盈利能力来衡量收购质量，我发现备考报表通过提高透明度缓解了激励一致性问题。预测方面的益处和激励一致性方面的益处集中在相同的子样本中，这表明当备考报表有助于预测盈利时，它们更有可能缓解激励一致性问题。

papers.abstract_original: Using a dataset of Chinese listed firms, we examine the relationship between Chinese nationals with foreign experience serving as directors (i.e., returnee directors) and the incidence of corporate fraud. We find a significantly negative relationship between returnee directors and fraud. Further, relative to foreign and independent directors, returnee directors do more than other directors in constraining firms’ fraud. These results are robust to endogeneity concerns addressed through propensity score matching and the Oster (2019) test. Further analyses show that the negative relationship between returnee directors and fraud is more pronounced when the returnees (i) have practical overseas work experience, (ii) work in conservative regions of China where the people are more culturally sensitive, and (iii) are appointed as independent directors. Collectively, the findings imply that technical skillset alone is insufficient for effective monitoring; the ability to work in a culturally sensitive manner and maintain professional independence are equally necessary.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们使用中国上市公司数据集，考察拥有海外经历的中国籍人士担任董事（即海归董事）与公司欺诈发生情况之间的关系。我们发现，海归董事与欺诈之间存在显著负相关关系。此外，相对于外籍董事和独立董事，海归董事在约束公司欺诈方面比其他董事发挥了更大作用。这些结果在通过倾向得分匹配和Oster（2019）检验处理内生性问题后依然稳健。进一步分析表明，当海归（i）拥有实际的海外工作经验，（ii）在中国文化上更为敏感的地区工作，以及（iii）被任命为独立董事时，海归董事与欺诈之间的负相关关系更为明显。总体而言，这些发现意味着，仅具备技术技能不足以实现有效监督；以文化敏感的方式开展工作的能力以及保持职业独立性同样必要。

papers.abstract_original: We identify a pecuniary externality arising from corporate tax avoidance. Firms share risk with the government via taxation. The lower the tax rate applied to a firm’s earnings, the more risk its shareholders bear. As more firms avoid taxes, the variance of the market’s after-tax cash flow increases. Consequently, the covariance of a firm’s cash flow with the market cash flow and thereby its cost of capital increases. This occurs regardless of a firm’s tax avoidance. Consistent with our prediction, we find that firms’ implied cost of capital relates positively to aggregate corporate tax avoidance regardless of a firm’s level of tax avoidance. As we predict, the pecuniary externality is stronger for firms whose cash flow covaries more with the market cash flow and is driven by tax avoidance strategies that reduce a firm’s marginal tax rate (e.g., income shifting of U.S. multinationals) as opposed to reducing its tax base.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们识别出企业避税所产生的一种货币外部性。企业通过税收与政府分担风险。适用于企业收益的税率越低，其股东承担的风险就越大。随着更多企业避税，市场税后现金流的方差增大。因此，企业现金流与市场现金流的协方差以及由此导致的资本成本上升。无论企业自身是否避税，这种情况都会发生。与我们的预测一致，我们发现，无论企业自身的避税程度如何，企业的隐含资本成本都与总体企业避税正相关。正如我们所预测的，对于现金流与市场现金流协方差更大的企业，这种货币外部性更强，并且它是由降低企业边际税率的避税策略（例如美国跨国公司的收入转移）而非缩小税基的避税策略所驱动的。

papers.abstract_original: Early empirical evidence showed a lack of relative performance evaluation (RPE) for executive pay, a surprise given its theoretical appeal. We hypothesize that executive pay transparency can enhance the monitoring of pay practices and increase RPE use. We examine RPE over the two decades centered on the 2006 executive pay disclosure reforms in the United States, which stakeholders—including shareholders, proxy advisors, and compensation consultants—could use to monitor pay plans. Firms that increase disclosures exhibit a significant increase in RPE after the reforms. To understand why, we examine and document that (i) stakeholder attention to pay practices increases after the reform, (ii) stakeholder attention positively relates to increases in RPE, and (iii) say-on-pay voting confirms shareholders’ preference for RPE. Overall, our findings are consistent with executive pay transparency increasing RPE due to enhanced pay monitoring across stakeholders.
papers.abstract_zh: 早期的实证证据显示，高管薪酬缺乏相对业绩评价（RPE），这与其理论上的吸引力形成反差，令人意外。我们假设，高管薪酬透明度能够加强对薪酬实践的监督，并提高RPE的使用。我们考察了以美国2006年高管薪酬披露改革为中心的二十年间的RPE，该改革使包括股东、代理顾问和薪酬顾问在内的利益相关者能够借此监督薪酬计划。提高披露程度的公司在改革后RPE显著上升。为理解其原因，我们考察并记录到：(i) 改革后利益相关者对薪酬实践的关注度上升，(ii) 利益相关者的关注度与RPE的上升正相关，(iii) 薪酬话语权投票证实了股东对RPE的偏好。总体而言，我们的发现与以下观点一致：高管薪酬透明度通过加强各利益相关者对薪酬的监督而提高了RPE。

papers.abstract_original: We examine whether and how language barriers influence a country’s decision to adopt International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS). Our findings reveal that as the distance between a country’s official language and English (i.e., linguistic distance) increases, the likelihood and speed of a country adopting IFRS decrease. Our evidence is consistent with the notion that language barriers impose significant information costs on preparers and users of financial reporting, making IFRS costlier to adopt for countries with severe language barriers. In further analysis, we find that such information costs materialize when these countries eventually adopt IFRS. Specifically, firms in countries with the most severe language barriers experience a worsened post-adoption information environment, as evidenced by increased analyst forecast errors and widened bid-ask spreads. Overall our study suggests that language barriers impede achievement of international accounting harmonization by increasing the costs associated with adopting, understanding, and applying IFRS.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考察语言障碍是否以及如何影响一个国家采用国际财务报告准则（IFRS）的决定。我们的研究发现表明，随着一个国家官方语言与英语之间的距离（即语言距离）增大，该国采用IFRS的可能性和速度都会下降。我们的证据与以下观点一致：语言障碍给财务报告编制者和使用者带来了显著的信息成本，使得语言障碍严重的国家采用IFRS的成本更高。在进一步分析中，我们发现，当这些国家最终采用IFRS时，此类信息成本会实际显现。具体而言，语言障碍最严重国家的公司在采用IFRS后信息环境恶化，表现为分析师预测误差增加和买卖价差扩大。总体而言，我们的研究表明，语言障碍通过增加与采用、理解和应用IFRS相关的成本，阻碍了国际会计趋同的实现。

papers.abstract_original: We examine how the development of voluntary sustainability standards has affected the nature of information covered in earnings calls. Using industry-specific dictionaries of sustainability terms contained in the disclosure standards developed by the Sustainability Accounting Standards Board (SASB), we find an increase in coverage of sustainability topics identified as relevant to investors in SASB standards, particularly for companies that had little or no coverage of sustainability issues historically. This trend begins around the time when SASB released a provisional standard for a given company’s industry and continues in the years afterward. We also find a stronger effect of SASB standards on conference call content for companies operating in industries with greater ex ante uncertainty about which sustainability topics are more likely to be financially material. Overall, our paper provides timely evidence as jurisdictions around the world consider whether to support sustainability reporting in their capital markets and, if so, how.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考察了自愿性可持续发展标准的发展如何影响了财报电话会议中所涵盖信息的性质。利用可持续发展会计准则委员会（SASB）制定的披露标准中所包含的行业特定可持续发展术语词典，我们发现，在SASB标准中被认定为与投资者相关的可持续发展主题的覆盖范围有所增加，尤其是对于那些历史上对可持续发展议题覆盖很少或完全没有覆盖的公司而言。这一趋势大约始于SASB发布针对某一公司所属行业的临时标准之时，并在其后数年持续存在。我们还发现，对于所处行业在哪些可持续发展主题更可能具有财务重要性方面事前不确定性更大的公司，SASB标准对电话会议内容的影响更强。总体而言，在世界各地司法管辖区考虑是否在其资本市场中支持可持续发展报告以及若支持应如何支持之际，我们的论文提供了及时的证据。

papers.abstract_original: This study examines whether companies realize operational benefits from engaging a new auditor recently dismissed by a competitor. While research shows that auditors can share information across clients, there is limited research on the potential impact of auditor information spillovers on clients’ operational outcomes. I find that companies that switch to a competitor’s former auditor realize significant improvements in operating performance and that this association varies predictably with several cross-sectional factors. I also find that these improvements are driven by increases in operating margins as opposed to revenue increases and that the outcomes of these switches are influenced by characteristics of the auditors and competitor companies involved in the switches. The pattern of these findings suggests that auditors may be sharing useful information with new clients after these switches. More broadly, the results suggest that the value of an audit (auditor) extends beyond the traditional considerations of capital market participants.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究考察公司聘用一位近期被竞争对手解聘的新审计师是否能获得运营收益。尽管研究表明审计师可以在客户之间共享信息，但关于审计师信息溢出对客户运营成果潜在影响的研究仍然有限。我发现，转向聘用竞争对手前审计师的公司实现了经营业绩的显著改善，并且这种关联与若干横截面因素呈现出可预测的变化关系。我还发现，这些改善是由营业利润率的提高而非收入的增加所驱动，并且这些更换审计师的结果受到参与更换的审计师和竞争对手公司特征的影响。这些发现的模式表明，审计师可能在此类更换之后与新客户分享了有用的信息。更广泛地说，结果表明审计（审计师）的价值超越了资本市场参与者的传统考量。

papers.abstract_original: This study examines the consequences of tax key audit matters (KAMs) to the valuation of tax attributes and to auditor-provided tax services (APTS). The literature finds that KAM adoption is not associated with investor or audit outcomes, creating an impetus to identify whether specific KAM topics are more consequential. Tax KAMs are an ideal setting because they are prevalent, taxes are economically important, and auditors can provide tax services to their clients. We find that investors discount the tax avoidance and deferred tax assets of tax-KAM companies, suggesting an incentive for managers to avoid tax KAMs. Consistent with self-interest threats to auditor independence, we find that receiving a tax KAM is negatively associated with clients’ concurrent purchases of APTS, but that clients increase their future purchases of these services when they stop receiving tax KAMs. These results reveal novel consequences of tax KAMs to the valuation of companies’ tax attributes and to APTS incentives.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究考察税务关键审计事项（KAMs）对税务属性估值以及审计师提供税务服务（APTS）的后果。文献发现，KAM的采用与投资者或审计结果并不相关，这促使人们去识别特定的KAM主题是否更具后果性。税务KAM是一个理想的研究情境，因为它们普遍存在、税收具有经济重要性，且审计师可以为其客户提供税务服务。我们发现，投资者会对税务KAM公司的避税和递延所得税资产进行折价，这表明管理者有动机去避免税务KAM。与审计师独立性面临的自我利益威胁相一致，我们发现，收到税务KAM与客户同期购买APTS呈负相关，但当客户不再收到税务KAM时，他们会增加未来对这些服务的购买。这些结果揭示了税务KAM对公司税务属性估值以及APTS激励的新颖后果。

papers.abstract_original: We use direct measures of information acquisition from a business intelligence service to provide descriptive evidence about small business managers’ information choices. We show that managers are heavy consumers of email pushes and dashboards but that consumption varies substantially over time and cross-sectionally. The information managers acquire largely facilitates performance monitoring; product, inventory, and staff management tools are also widely used. Cross-sectional analyses provide support for economic motivators such as business complexity, and within-store analyses raise the possibility that hedonic motivations matter—that is, managers appear to consume information, at least in part, based on their expectation of how the information will make them feel. Still, on net, information acquisition appears productive, as greater acquisition predicts higher sales and fewer stockouts. Overall, our study provides micro-level evidence on managerial information acquisition, an important input into the design and use of increasingly pervasive data products such as dashboards.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们使用来自一项商业智能服务的信息获取直接度量，提供关于小企业管理者信息选择的描述性证据。我们表明，管理者是电子邮件推送和仪表板的重度使用者，但使用情况在时间上和横截面上差异很大。管理者获取的信息主要有助于绩效监控；产品、库存和员工管理工具也被广泛使用。横截面分析为诸如业务复杂性等经济动因提供了支持，而店内分析提出了享乐动机可能起作用的可能性——也就是说，管理者似乎至少部分基于他们对信息将如何让自己感觉的预期来消费信息。尽管如此，净效应上，信息获取似乎是有成效的，因为更多的获取预示着更高的销售额和更少的缺货。总体而言，我们的研究提供了关于管理者信息获取的微观层面证据，而这是设计和使诸如仪表板等日益普遍的数据产品得以使用的重要投入。

papers.abstract_original: We exploit differences in two industry classification schemes to distinguish between industry classification misfits and industry core firms. We posit that misfits differ from their industry peers, and we document consequences of this heterogeneity. Misfits have larger absolute abnormal accruals, firms in industries with a greater proportion of misfits have larger absolute abnormal accruals, and contemporaneous abnormal accruals are associated with future restatements for industry core firms but not for misfits. We attribute these results to measurement error generated by the inclusion of misfits in the estimation of accrual models. We then provide guidance to alleviate this issue. For both misfits and industry core firms, using fixed peer groups based on the largest firms in a given industry significantly outperforms other peer selection methods in detecting abnormal accruals. In additional analyses, we highlight other economic consequences of industry classification misfits such as higher information processing costs.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们利用两种行业分类方案之间的差异，来区分行业分类错配企业与行业核心企业。我们假定错配企业与其行业同行存在差异，并记录了这种异质性所带来的后果。错配企业具有更大的绝对异常应计；错配企业比例较高的行业中的企业具有更大的绝对异常应计；对于行业核心企业而言，当期异常应计与未来重述相关，但对于错配企业则不然。我们将这些结果归因于将错配企业纳入应计模型估计所产生的计量误差。随后，我们提供指引以缓解这一问题。对于错配企业和行业核心企业而言，使用基于某一给定行业中最大企业构建的固定同业组，在检测异常应计方面显著优于其他同业选择方法。在补充分析中，我们强调了行业分类错配的其他经济后果，例如更高的信息处理成本。
