papers.abstract_original: Seminal papers by Ball and Brown (1968) and Beaver (1968) spawned a vast literature on the role of accounting numbers in capital markets. This literature, often referred to as capital markets research in accounting (CMRA), is now more than a half-century old. In light of numerous changes to the economic and financial reporting environments over this time, we estimate CMRA’s major relations using a comprehensive sample period. We illustrate each relation using plots, allowing us to efficiently present CMRA’s first half-century consistent with the adage “a picture is worth a thousand words.” The aims of our study are to document the extent of time-series variation in CMRA’s major relations and to provide evidence on market-level determinants of that variation. In doing so, our study provides a natural starting point for future research designed to develop and test additional causal explanations for time-series variation in the properties of CMRA’s major relations.
papers.abstract_zh: Ball和Brown（1968）以及Beaver（1968）的开创性论文催生了大量关于会计数字在资本市场中作用的文献。这一文献通常被称为会计学中的资本市场研究（CMRA），至今已有半个多世纪的历史。鉴于在此期间经济与财务报告环境发生了诸多变化，我们使用一个覆盖全面的样本期来估计CMRA的主要关系。我们通过图形来展示每一种关系，从而能够高效地呈现CMRA的第一个半世纪，契合“一图胜千言”的格言。本研究的目标是记录CMRA主要关系中时间序列变异的程度，并就这种变异的市场层面决定因素提供证据。通过这样做，我们的研究为未来旨在开发和检验对CMRA主要关系属性的时间序列变异提供更多因果解释的研究提供了一个自然的起点。

papers.abstract_original: We use publicly available information to estimate the country location of multinational firms’ cash holdings, examine why investors discount the value of cash held overseas, and examine whether that discount changes after the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (TCJA) of 2017. We provide three main results. papers.abstract_original: This paper investigates how tax loss carryforward (LCF) rules influence corporate bankruptcies and market-wide productivity. Analyzing data from 29 European countries, I find that stricter LCF deductibility limits significantly increase bankruptcy likelihoods. This is because stricter LCF deductibility limits lower the present value of net operating losses (NOLs) as tax assets, reducing the incentive to keep struggling firms alive. This effect is especially pronounced for business group firms, which can support struggling affiliates through internal capital markets to strategically exploit NOLs. My results suggest that lenient LCF deductibility limits can sustain unproductive firms, impacting market-wide resource allocation and productivity. These findings highlight the trade-off in tax policy between supporting firm survival and ensuring efficient resource allocation.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文研究税收亏损结转（LCF）规则如何影响企业破产和全市场生产率。通过分析来自29个欧洲国家的数据，我发现更严格的LCF扣除限制显著提高了破产可能性。这是因为更严格的LCF扣除限制降低了净经营亏损（NOL）作为税收资产的现值，从而削弱了让陷入困境的企业继续存续的激励。这一效应在企业集团企业中尤为明显，这些企业可以通过内部资本市场支持陷入困境的关联企业，以策略性地利用NOL。我的结果表明，宽松的LCF扣除限制可能维持非生产性企业，影响全市场资源配置和生产率。这些发现凸显了税收政策在支持企业存续与确保有效资源配置之间的权衡。

papers.abstract_original: We investigate whether U.S. House representatives and their staff seek financial information from constituent firms to inform their legislative decisions. We exploit shifts in U.S. congressional districts (i.e., the reconfiguration of federal district lines or redistricting) that introduce new constituent firms to legislators’ districts. To the extent that legislators and their staff collect and rely on firms’ financial statement information, we expect that a change in representation as a result of redistricting will result in a significant and observable change in searches for information about new constituent firms. Our evidence supports this prediction. We also find that the timing of searching coincides with legislators’ roll call votes, particularly ahead of more controversial bills and for bills lobbied by sample firms. Finally, we find that new constituent firms respond to increased information demands after a redistricting event by supplying more policy-relevant disclosures and increasing lobbying.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究美国众议院议员及其工作人员是否会向所在选区的企业寻求财务信息，以为其立法决策提供依据。我们利用美国国会选区的变动（即联邦选区边界的重新划分或选区重划）作为研究契机，这种变动会将新的选区企业引入立法者所代表的选区。如果立法者及其工作人员确实收集并依赖企业的财务报表信息，那么我们预期，因选区重划而导致的代表权变更将引起对新的选区企业信息搜索的显著且可观察的变化。我们的证据支持这一预测。我们还发现，搜索的时机与立法者的唱名表决相吻合，尤其是在争议性较大的法案表决之前，以及样本企业进行游说的法案表决之前。最后，我们发现新的选区企业在选区重划事件后，会通过提供更多与政策相关的披露以及增加游说活动，来回应信息需求的增加。

papers.abstract_original: We evaluate how well generative AI can perform an important task—identifying product market competitors (“peers”). We find that machine-generated peers have a high overlap with the peers identified by human experts as well as with the peers identified by established peer identification systems. Machine-generated peers have high correlations with the focal firm in stock returns, sales growth, and gross profit margin in the subsequent year. The correlations are stronger than those derived from identifying peers by analyzing the similarity of business descriptions in annual reports or by using members in the focal firm’s SIC industry. Machine-generated peers also exhibit higher homogeneity among themselves than those identified via the two alternative systems. We demonstrate the usefulness of machine-generated peers in two settings: (1) compensation benchmarking by investors and (2) hypothesis testing by researchers. Overall, our findings suggest that generative AI can identify peer firms reasonably well, especially for large firms.

papers.abstract_original: The channels through which analyst research data are distributed are complex. The I/B/E/S database is the dominant source for analyst earnings estimates for academics, but there are numerous other channels, some of which are cost prohibitive for many investors. We describe the distribution of analyst research and examine whether a high-cost alternative distribution channel, TR Research, is characterized by higher quality estimates than those available from I/B/E/S. We examine analyst forecast accuracy, bias, and informativeness and find that TR Research estimates are more accurate and less biased than estimates exclusively distributed via I/B/E/S. We further find that TR Research estimates are associated with greater market reaction and lower information asymmetry, consistent with the higher quality of these estimates. Our study highlights differences in brokerage and analyst incentives regarding research distribution and documents a specific setting where a subset of investors pays for access to superior analyst research.
papers.abstract_zh: 分析师研究数据的传播渠道十分复杂。I/B/E/S数据库是学术界获取分析师盈利预测的主要来源，但还存在众多其他渠道，其中一些渠道对许多投资者而言成本高得令人望而却步。我们描述了分析师研究的传播情况，并考察了一个高成本的替代传播渠道——TR Research——其特征是否在于其预测质量高于I/B/E/S所提供的预测。我们考察了分析师预测的准确性、偏差和信息含量，发现TR Research的预测比仅通过I/B/E/S传播的预测更准确、偏差更小。我们进一步发现，TR Research的预测与更大的市场反应和更低的信息不对称相关，这与这些预测质量更高相一致。我们的研究凸显了经纪商和分析师在研究传播方面激励的差异，并记录了一个特定情境，即一部分投资者付费获取更优质的分析师研究。

papers.abstract_original: We examine whether variation in regulatory leniency is associated with the cost of deposits in the banking industry. We predict that lenient regulatory supervision allows for greater bank risk-taking due to delayed intervention, resulting in a higher cost of deposits. Our main finding is a positive association between banks’ cost of uninsured deposits and the leniency of their state regulators, incremental to observable measures of risk and performance. We further show that this result is stronger for riskier banks and when uninsured depositors have a greater ability or incentive to influence deposit rates. These findings suggest that the leniency of bank regulators is priced in uninsured deposit rates and further our understanding of the factors associated with regulatory leniency in the banking industry.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考察监管宽松程度的变化是否与银行业存款成本相关。我们预测，宽松的监管监督会因延迟干预而允许银行承担更大的风险，从而导致更高的存款成本。我们的主要发现是，银行未保险存款成本与其州监管机构的宽松程度呈正相关，且这一关系在可观察的风险和业绩指标之外仍然存在。我们进一步表明，这一结果在风险较高的银行以及未保险存款人更有能力或更有动机影响存款利率时更为显著。这些发现表明，银行监管机构的宽松程度已被计入未保险存款利率，并进一步加深了我们对银行业监管宽松相关因素的理解。

papers.abstract_original: This study examines the relation between U.S. managers’ short-term exposure to air pollution and their forecasting ability. We focus on air pollution due to PM 2.5 , a fine particulate matter that can easily penetrate an indoor, climate-controlled environment. We show that the short-term ambient PM 2.5 level at the firm’s headquarters before a management earnings forecast issuance is negatively associated with the accuracy of the forecast. Also, the short-term ambient PM 2.5 level before an earnings announcement is negatively related to the likelihood of a concurrent management forecast issuance. These relations occur at PM 2.5 levels below the U.S. air quality standard. A battery of additional tests validate these findings. These results suggest that a transitory exposure to PM 2.5 at levels common in the United States temporarily decreases managers’ forecasting ability. The temporary cognitive impairment from short-term exposure to modest levels of PM 2.5 , as documented in epidemiological studies, is presumably the reason.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究考察美国管理者短期暴露于空气污染与其预测能力之间的关系。我们关注由PM2.5造成的空气污染，PM2.5是一种细颗粒物，能够轻易穿透室内受气候控制的环境。我们发现，在管理层发布盈余预测之前，公司总部所在地的短期环境PM2.5水平与预测准确性呈负相关。此外，在盈余公告之前的短期环境PM2.5水平与同时发布管理层预测的可能性呈负相关。这些关系发生在低于美国空气质量标准的PM2.5水平上。一系列额外检验验证了这些发现。这些结果表明，在美国常见的PM2.5水平下短暂暴露会暂时降低管理者的预测能力。流行病学研究所记录的短期暴露于适度PM2.5水平所导致的暂时性认知损伤，推测是其原因。

papers.abstract_original: This study examines whether auditor KAM disclosures about M&A transactions predict future performance outcomes. We find that auditors make more M&A KAM disclosures when M&A transactions are larger, involve targets with greater information asymmetry, and are subject to greater overpayment risk. When auditors disclose M&A KAMs in the acquisition year, we find an increased risk of larger goodwill impairments and that the association between acquired goodwill and changes in companies’ subsequent operating performance are significantly lower compared to when auditors do not issue an M&A KAM. We also find that the likelihood of forced CEO turnover is incrementally higher when subsequent operating performance is poor and auditors issue an M&A KAM compared to when they do not. Collectively, our findings suggest that these auditor disclosures reflect uncertainty that predicts weak post-acquisition performance and forced CEO turnover, incremental to other indicators of failed acquisition strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究考察审计师关于并购交易的关键审计事项（KAM）披露能否预测未来业绩结果。我们发现，当并购交易规模更大、标的公司信息不对称程度更高、且面临更大的超额支付风险时，审计师会作出更多并购KAM披露。当审计师在收购年度披露并购KAM时，我们发现更大的商誉减值风险上升，并且与审计师未发布并购KAM时相比，所收购商誉与公司后续经营业绩变化之间的关联显著更低。我们还发现，当后续经营业绩不佳且审计师发布并购KAM时，与未发布时相比，强制CEO更替的可能性增量更高。总体而言，我们的发现表明，这些审计师披露反映了不确定性，而这种不确定性能够预测收购后业绩疲弱和强制CEO更替，且其作用独立于其他失败收购策略的指标。

papers.abstract_original: We estimate investors’ disagreement regarding firm news and assess its ability to predict stock returns. Specifically, we quantify firm-level investor disagreement through the volume-volatility elasticity surrounding firm news; higher elasticity is associated with less investor disagreement. Intuitively, disagreement introduces additional trading motives that are not driven by price changes, weakening the connection between volume and volatility. Our findings indicate that investor disagreement on news negatively predicts cross-sectional returns. We also present empirical evidence aligned with the theoretical predictions of a recently developed model by Atmaz and Basak (Journal of Finance 73 (3): 1225–1279 2018) that the negative disagreement-stock relation strengthens when the optimism effect dominates the uncertainty effect. Importantly, this predictive relationship remains robust after controlling for news heterogeneity, other volume- and volatility-based measures, and alternative channels.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们估计投资者对公司新闻的分歧，并评估其预测股票收益的能力。具体而言，我们通过围绕公司新闻的成交量-波动率弹性来量化公司层面的投资者分歧；较高的弹性与较少的投资者分歧相关。直观上，分歧引入了并非由价格变化驱动的额外交易动机，从而削弱了成交量与波动率之间的联系。我们的研究结果表明，投资者对新闻的分歧负向预测横截面收益。我们还提供了与Atmaz和Basak（Journal of Finance 73 (3): 1225–1279 2018）最近提出的模型的理论预测相一致的实证证据，即当乐观效应主导不确定性效应时，分歧与股票之间的负向关系会增强。重要的是，在控制了新闻异质性、其他基于成交量和波动率的度量以及替代渠道之后，这种预测关系仍然稳健。

papers.abstract_original: We study the dynamics of information demand and supply in capital markets, focusing on how firms’ disclosures align with analysts’ information needs. Using a novel dataset from Visible Alpha, we analyze granular data from analysts’ forecasting models to understand the breadth of information they seek and how firms meet these demands through mandatory and voluntary disclosures. We document significant variation in the complexity of analysts’ models and the extent of firms’ disclosures, leading to some items in analysts’ models remaining undisclosed. This unmet information demand gives rise to a novel concept we term “uncertainty about the past” ( UP ). We investigate its implications for key capital market outcomes, including analyst forecast dispersion, market reactions to earnings announcements, and stock market liquidity. Our results demonstrate that UP plays a significant role in shaping the information environment, challenging the assumption that earnings announcements fully resolve uncertainty about past performance.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究资本市场中信息需求与信息供给的动态关系，重点关注公司披露如何与分析师的信息需求相匹配。利用来自Visible Alpha的一个新颖数据集，我们分析分析师预测模型中的细粒度数据，以理解其所需信息的广度，以及公司如何通过强制性和自愿性披露来满足这些需求。我们记录了分析师模型复杂性与公司披露程度存在显著差异，导致分析师模型中的某些项目仍未被披露。这种未被满足的信息需求催生了一个我们称之为“关于过去的不确定性”（UP）的新概念。我们考察其对关键资本市场结果的影响，包括分析师预测离散度、市场对盈余公告的反应以及股票市场流动性。我们的结果表明，UP在塑造信息环境中发挥着重要作用，挑战了盈余公告能够完全解决关于过去业绩的不确定性这一假设。

papers.abstract_original: The new lease standard (ASC 842) allows firms to keep variable leases off balance sheet, in part based on the assumption that future expenses are difficult to estimate reliably. We show that variable lease expenses are both prevalent and substantial, exhibiting persistence and predictability comparable to operating lease expenses while showing limited sensitivity to revenue changes. These patterns are consistent with variable lease payments being based on stable drivers. Following ASC 842 adoption, firms report lower minimum operating lease commitments and higher variable lease expenses, suggesting a substitution from operating to variable leases. Neither equity betas nor credit ratings reflect potential variable lease liabilities. Conservative estimates show that recognition of variable lease liabilities would increase debt by 7.1% on average. Our findings provide evidence on the properties of variable leases and the potential implications of keeping them off balance sheet.
papers.abstract_zh: 新的租赁准则（ASC 842）允许企业将可变租赁保持在资产负债表外，部分原因是基于未来费用难以可靠估计的假设。我们发现，可变租赁费用既普遍又金额重大，其持续性和可预测性与经营租赁费用相当，同时对收入变化的敏感性有限。这些模式与可变租赁付款基于稳定驱动因素的情况一致。在采用ASC 842之后，企业报告的最低经营租赁承诺更低，可变租赁费用更高，表明从经营租赁向可变租赁的替代。股权贝塔值和信用评级均未反映潜在的可变租赁负债。保守估计显示，确认可变租赁负债将使债务平均增加7.1%。我们的发现为可变租赁的特征以及将其保持在资产负债表外的潜在影响提供了证据。

papers.abstract_original: We provide an economics-based review of the pros and cons of ESG disclosures, emphasizing environmental disclosures from an investor-centric perspective. Our survey intends to guide corporate management and regulators in navigating the ESG disclosure terrain. Rather than summarizing the vast and growing ESG literature, we assess the economic arguments for ESG disclosure regulation and the form of this disclosure. We discuss investors’ demand for ESG information and its supply by publicly traded firms. We analyze the case for and against mandatory ESG disclosure. Finally, we weigh the efficiency of disclosure requirement characteristics, assuming mandatory ESG disclosure is warranted. We intend to be positive rather than prescriptive, providing a line of reasoning readers can employ to reach their own conclusions about what we ought to do.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们从以投资者为中心的视角，对ESG披露的利弊进行了一项基于经济学的综述，重点聚焦于环境披露。我们的综述旨在为公司管理层和监管机构在ESG披露领域提供指引。我们并非对庞大且不断增长的ESG文献进行总结，而是评估ESG披露监管的经济学论据以及这种披露的形式。我们讨论了投资者对ESG信息的需求以及上市公司对ESG信息的供给。我们分析了支持与反对强制性ESG披露的理由。最后，在假定强制性ESG披露具有合理性的前提下，我们权衡了披露要求各项特征的效率。我们的意图是实证性的而非规定性的，提供一条推理思路，使读者能够据此就我们应当做什么得出自己的结论。

papers.abstract_original: Market participants have called on the SEC to address the lack of disclosures about firms’ environmental impacts, investments, and exposures. However, the frictions that obstruct the flow of environmental information are not well understood. I shed light on these frictions by examining whether scrutiny by the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) restricts the firm’s voluntary environmental disclosures in earnings conference calls. Consistent with the notion that EPA scrutiny gives rise to disclosure frictions, I find a negative relation between EPA scrutiny and the environmental disclosures of scrutinized firms. This negative relation is concentrated among firms without environmental expert directors, suggesting that environmental governance mitigates the chilling effect of EPA scrutiny. In terms of disclosure quality, I show that environmental disclosures include fewer quantitative details under EPA scrutiny. Collectively, these findings provide insights into the frictions that restrict the flow of environmental information to market participants, an important issue given the SEC’s efforts to improve current disclosure practices.
papers.abstract_zh: 市场参与者呼吁SEC解决公司环境影响、投资和风险敞口方面信息披露不足的问题。然而，阻碍环境信息流动的摩擦因素尚未得到充分理解。我通过考察环境保护署（EPA）的审查是否限制了公司在收益电话会议中的自愿性环境信息披露，来揭示这些摩擦因素。与EPA审查会引发披露摩擦的观点一致，我发现EPA审查与被审查公司的环境信息披露之间存在负相关关系。这种负相关关系集中存在于没有环境专家董事的公司中，表明环境治理缓解了EPA审查的寒蝉效应。在披露质量方面，我表明在EPA审查下，环境信息披露包含的定量细节更少。总体而言，这些发现为限制环境信息流向市场参与者的摩擦因素提供了洞见，鉴于SEC努力改进当前披露实践，这是一个重要问题。

papers.abstract_original: We study the role of CFO narcissism in the intent and ability to positively influence sell-side analysts’ perceptions of the firm. Consistent with narcissists casting favorable impressions on others, we find CFO narcissism is associated with overly optimistic analyst valuations. We then study public persuasion attempts by analyzing conference call transcripts and private persuasion attempts through a laboratory study. In the conference call setting, we show that narcissistic CFOs use more persuasive language and are more inclined to call on bearish analysts, both of which we link to price target revisions following the call. In the lab study, we simulate a one-on-one conversation and find that narcissists are especially more likely to use coercive methods to induce higher valuations from analysts. Collectively, we show that narcissistic CFOs use persuasion to favorably influence analysts’ perceptions of firm value.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究首席财务官自恋在意图和能力方面对积极影响卖方分析师对公司看法的所起的作用。与自恋者给他人留下良好印象相一致，我们发现首席财务官自恋与分析师过于乐观的估值相关。随后，我们通过分析电话会议记录来研究公开劝说尝试，并通过一项实验室研究来研究私下劝说尝试。在电话会议情境中，我们表明自恋的首席财务官使用更具劝说力的语言，并且更倾向于让看空分析师提问，我们将这两者与电话会议后的目标价修正联系起来。在实验室研究中，我们模拟了一对一对话，发现自恋者尤其更可能使用强制方法来诱导分析师给出更高的估值。总体而言，我们表明自恋的首席财务官使用劝说以有利地影响分析师对公司价值的看法。

papers.abstract_original: Using a novel measure that captures negative ESG incidents at both listed and private suppliers, we provide large-scale evidence on the value implications of supply chain ESG. We find that firms with fewer supply chain ESG incidents exhibit higher future accounting performance and that this effect is stronger in the presence of more conscious customers and vulnerable supply chains. We also find that firms with robust supply chain ESG exhibit higher future stock returns and that this effect is more pronounced when information frictions are higher, which suggests that it takes time for the market to understand the value implications of supply chain ESG. Overall, we highlight the benefits of managing supply chain ESG and the decision usefulness of the related information.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们使用一种新颖的衡量指标，捕捉上市供应商和私营供应商的负面ESG事件，从而就供应链ESG的价值含义提供了大规模证据。我们发现，供应链ESG事件较少的企业表现出更高的未来会计业绩，并且在客户意识更强、供应链更脆弱的情况下，这一效应更强。我们还发现，供应链ESG稳健的企业表现出更高的未来股票回报，并且在信息摩擦更高时，这一效应更为明显，这表明市场需要时间才能理解供应链ESG的价值含义。总体而言，我们强调了管理供应链ESG的益处以及相关信息的决策有用性。

papers.abstract_original: Against the backdrop of an increasing threat of misinformation on social media, several countries have enacted regulations to curb the spread of misinformation. This study examines how corporate social media strategy responds to misinformation regulations. Using a large cross-country dataset of corporate tweets and a stacked regression analysis, we show that misinformation regulations lead to less corporate social media disclosure. This result suggests that, by deterring misinformation, these regulations reduce firms’ need to use social media to counteract its adverse effects. Additional analyses show that the effect strengthens among countries with higher social media usage and those with stronger investor protection but weakens for firms with stronger information environments. Finally, we provide direct evidence that firms post fewer tweets refuting misinformation about themselves following the enactment of these regulations.
papers.abstract_zh: 在社交媒体上虚假信息威胁日益加剧的背景下，若干国家已颁布法规以遏制虚假信息的传播。本研究考察企业社交媒体策略如何应对虚假信息监管。利用一个大型跨国企业推文数据集和堆叠回归分析，我们表明虚假信息监管导致企业社交媒体披露减少。这一结果表明，通过威慑虚假信息，这些法规降低了企业利用社交媒体以抵消其不利影响的必要性。进一步分析显示，在社交媒体使用率较高的国家以及投资者保护较强的国家，这一效应更强，但对于信息环境较强的企业，这一效应减弱。最后，我们提供直接证据表明，在这些法规颁布后，企业发布的驳斥关于自身虚假信息的推文减少。

papers.abstract_original: This study investigates the role of individual managers in banks’ financial reporting. We exploit the connectedness between different managers and find that individual bank managers explain approximately 19 percent of banks’ loan loss provisions. This observation is consistent with the substantial reporting discretion that individual bank managers use in the estimation of loan loss provisions and that is increasingly subject to financial stability concerns by prudential supervisors. Our results suggest that these concerns are valid, as individual management discretion is associated with greater discretionary loan loss provisions and proxies for opportunistic accounting, especially the reduction in the timeliness of these provisions and the lesser degree to which the allowance for credit losses maps into future charge-offs. These findings are relevant for the design of regulatory measures aimed at limiting the managerial influence on accounting choices in banking and can inform debates on the desirability of discretion within the reporting process of banks.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究考察个体管理者在银行财务报告中的作用。我们利用不同管理者之间的关联性，发现个体银行管理者可解释银行约19%的贷款损失拨备。这一观察结果与个体银行管理者在估计贷款损失拨备时运用大量报告自由裁量权相一致，而这种自由裁量权日益受到审慎监管机构对金融稳定担忧的关注。我们的结果表明，这些担忧是有根据的，因为个体管理层的自由裁量权与更高的可自由裁量贷款损失拨备以及机会主义会计的代理变量相关，尤其是这些拨备及时性的降低，以及信用损失准备映射到未来核销的程度较低。这些发现对于旨在限制管理层对银行业会计选择影响的监管措施设计具有相关性，并可为关于银行报告过程中自由裁量权是否可取的争论提供参考。

papers.abstract_original: We study how global changes in information acquisition costs through disclosure technologies affect price informativeness. To explore this issue, we examine worldwide adoptions of centralized electronic disclosure systems, which significantly reduce the cost of and broaden access to financial disclosures. Consistent with theory, we show a significant reduction in private information acquisition around earnings announcements as a result of these adoptions. These effects are most pronounced in countries with the most substantial reductions in information acquisition costs and where we find more significant decreases in informed trade. Overall, we highlight an important, unintended cost of broadening access to financial disclosures through technology adoptions.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究通过披露技术带来的信息获取成本的全球变化如何影响价格信息含量。为探讨这一问题，我们考察了集中式电子披露系统在世界范围内的采用，这些系统显著降低了财务披露的成本并拓宽了其获取渠道。与理论一致，我们表明，由于这些采用，围绕盈余公告的私人信息获取显著减少。这些效应在信息获取成本降幅最大的国家最为显著，并且在这些国家我们发现知情交易下降更为显著。总体而言，我们强调了通过技术采用拓宽财务披露获取渠道所带来的一项重要且非预期的成本。

papers.abstract_original: The Dodd-Frank Act expands bank managers’ reporting requirements to federal agencies, particularly relating to banks’ financial losses should common market and macroeconomic shocks occur. To comply with this regulation, bank managers have engaged in consulting arrangements (referred to as regulatory consulting). We examine the financial reporting quality implications associated with hiring external auditors for these services. We find banks with auditor-provided regulatory consulting, relative to banks without, have higher financial reporting quality as measured by loan loss provision validity. Consistent with knowledge spillover benefits accruing to financial audit teams, we find more pronounced effects in the fourth versus interim quarters and more frequent income-reducing Y9-C restatements. We also find auditor responsiveness to PCAOB inspections improves the effectiveness of regulatory consulting. Overall, our results suggest regulatory consulting improves the audits of estimates in judgmental financial statement accounts, despite regulatory concerns that these services may impair auditor independence.
papers.abstract_zh: 《多德-弗兰克法案》扩大了银行管理层向联邦机构报告的要求，尤其涉及在共同市场和宏观经济冲击发生时银行的财务损失。为遵守这一监管规定，银行管理层采用了咨询安排（称为监管咨询）。我们考察了聘请外部审计师提供这些服务所伴随的财务报告质量影响。我们发现，与没有审计师提供监管咨询的银行相比，有审计师提供监管咨询的银行具有更高的财务报告质量，其衡量指标为贷款损失准备的有效性。与知识溢出收益惠及财务审计团队相一致，我们发现这种效应在第四季度比在中期季度更为明显，并且收入减少型的Y9-C重述更为频繁。我们还发现，审计师对PCAOB检查的响应性提高了监管咨询的有效性。总体而言，我们的结果表明，监管咨询改善了对需要判断的财务报表账户中估计值的审计，尽管监管机构担心这些服务可能损害审计师的独立性。

papers.abstract_original: The Sustainability Accounting Standards Board (SASB) has classified sustainability topics as material or not material for investors. We leverage the staggered release of the SASB classifications from 2013 to 2016 to examine whether and how they prompt changes in U.S. firms’ sustainability performance. We measure sustainability performance using RepRisk scores, which reflect environmental, social, and governance (ESG) incidents. We find that RepRisk scores on sustainability topics classified as material decrease following the release of SASB classifications. Conversely, incident scores on nonmaterial sustainability topics increase. This suggests that firms improve their sustainability performance on topics the SASB deems relevant for investors while simultaneously performing worse on irrelevant topics. Firms adjust their internal sustainability policies to mirror these changes. The changes in sustainability performance occur primarily through two channels. We document that higher exposure to the classifications from shareholder pressure and sustainability-linked executive compensation prompts managers to prioritize sustainability topics classified as relevant for investors over irrelevant ones.
papers.abstract_zh: 可持续性会计准则委员会（SASB）将可持续性议题分类为对投资者具有重要性或不具有重要性。我们利用SASB分类在2013年至2016年间交错发布这一特点，考察这些分类是否以及如何促使美国公司的可持续性表现发生变化。我们使用RepRisk评分来衡量可持续性表现，该评分反映环境、社会和治理（ESG）事件。我们发现，在被分类为具有重要性的可持续性议题上，RepRisk评分在SASB分类发布后下降。相反，在非重要性可持续性议题上，事件评分上升。这表明，公司在SASB认为与投资者相关的议题上改善了其可持续性表现，同时在无关议题上表现得更差。公司调整其内部可持续性政策以反映这些变化。可持续性表现的变化主要通过两个渠道发生。我们记录到，来自股东压力的分类暴露程度更高以及可持续性挂钩的高管薪酬，促使管理者将与投资者相关的可持续性议题置于无关议题之上。

papers.abstract_original: We provide a comprehensive overview of accounting-related regulatory changes (financial accounting, auditing, tax, and other disclosures) in the 27 European Union countries and the United Kingdom since 1993 based on an extensive literature review, survey, and topic and country expert input. Across all countries and years, we find that more than 16 regulatory events occur in a typical difference-in-differences research design that includes pre- and post-periods of four years. On average 3.4 out of four accounting disciplines are affected, emphasizing the need for interdisciplinary awareness. Our accompanying website ( http://www.eu-regulations.com ) offers visual representations of these events, regulation summaries, literature links, and source documents, all by country. This work aims to (1) lower the cost for researchers, reviewers, and editors to understand the EU’s evolving regulatory landscape; (2) improve research designs by identifying concurrent regulatory events; and (3) highlight research opportunities for those studying the EU or specific member states.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们基于广泛的文献综述、问卷调查以及主题和国家专家的意见，全面概述了自1993年以来欧盟27个国家和英国与会计相关的监管变化（财务会计、审计、税务及其他披露）。在所有国家和所有年份中，我们发现，在一个包含四年前期和四年后期的典型双重差分研究设计中，会发生超过16项监管事件。平均而言，四分之三的会计学科中有3.4个受到影响，这凸显了跨学科意识的必要性。我们随附的网站（http://www.eu-regulations.com）按国家提供了这些事件的可视化呈现、监管摘要、文献链接和源文件。这项工作旨在：(1) 降低研究人员、审稿人和编辑理解欧盟不断演变的监管格局的成本；(2) 通过识别同时发生的监管事件来改进研究设计；(3) 为研究欧盟或特定成员国的人士突出研究机会。

papers.abstract_original: We use unique disclosures in the insurance industry to examine whether client-engaged specialists (i.e., external actuaries) affect opportunism within the claim loss reserve. Using a fixed-effects approach, we find that external actuaries significantly affect the opportunism in the claim loss reserve, approaching half the effect of the auditor. With respect to actuary characteristics, we find a positive (negative) association between actuary permissiveness (actuary size) and opportunism in the claim loss reserve. In additional analyses, we find that the relation between actuary permissiveness and claim loss reserve opportunism is stronger when insurers have incentives to opportunistically manage the claim loss reserve. This relation continues to persist in the presence of high-quality auditors. Overall, we provide evidence suggesting that client-engaged external actuaries can be used to support opportunistic claim loss reserve estimates.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们利用保险业特有的披露信息，考察客户聘请的专家（即外部精算师）是否会影响索赔损失准备金中的机会主义行为。采用固定效应方法，我们发现外部精算师显著影响索赔损失准备金中的机会主义行为，其影响接近审计师影响的一半。就精算师特征而言，我们发现精算师的宽松程度（精算师规模）与索赔损失准备金中的机会主义行为呈正（负）相关关系。在进一步分析中，我们发现当保险公司有动机机会主义地管理索赔损失准备金时，精算师宽松程度与索赔损失准备金机会主义行为之间的关系更强。在存在高质量审计师的情况下，这种关系依然持续存在。总体而言，我们提供的证据表明，客户聘请的外部精算师可被用来支持机会主义的索赔损失准备金估计。

papers.abstract_original: A primary argument against fair value measurement is the lack of verifiability, where verifiability is defined as consensus in measurement by independent parties. We evaluate this argument by investigating trends in the consensus of reported fair values. Our findings indicate that consensus increased between 2005 and 2019, as evidenced by reductions in the fair value range and standard deviation. Further analyses suggest that enhanced data availability—driven by public dissemination of trade information—serves as a mechanism for this trend. We also document that securities subject to testing by larger external auditors with more resources to take advantage of enhanced data availability are associated with a stronger trend in increasing consensus. Finally, this trend appears to be stronger in situations when management has a heightened opportunity to record a biased estimate. While conventional arguments express concern over management’s ability to manipulate fair values, our results demonstrate patterns consistent with improved verifiability.
papers.abstract_zh: 反对公允价值计量的一个主要论点是缺乏可验证性，而可验证性被定义为独立各方在计量上达成共识。我们通过考察所报告公允价值的共识趋势来评估这一论点。我们的研究结果表明，2005年至2019年间共识有所增加，公允价值区间和标准差的缩小即为证据。进一步的分析表明，由交易信息公开发布所推动的数据可得性增强，是这一趋势的一个机制。我们还发现，由拥有更多资源以利用增强的数据可得性的较大外部审计师进行测试的证券，与共识增强趋势更强相关。最后，当管理层有更大机会记录有偏估计时，这一趋势似乎更强。尽管传统论点对管理层操纵公允价值的能力表示担忧，我们的结果展示出与可验证性改善相一致的模式。

papers.abstract_original: Recent years have witnessed significant growth in corporate sustainability reporting. Yet existing research provides mixed evidence on the information content of these reports for investors. We examine the stock market reaction to the announcement of a sample of US corporate sustainability reports incorporating Sustainability Accounting Standards Board metrics that are intended to provide financially material information to investors. Using standard measures of information content, we cannot find compelling evidence that these reports provide a significant amount of new information to investors. Further analysis of a subset of common metrics indicates that they are either financially immaterial or preempted by traditional financial disclosures. Finally, we show that most firms target their sustainability reports at a broad set of sustainability-oriented stakeholders rather than a narrow set of financially oriented investors.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，企业可持续发展报告显著增长。然而，现有研究对这些报告对投资者的信息含量提供了混合证据。我们考察了市场对一组美国企业可持续发展报告公告的股价反应，这些报告纳入了可持续发展会计准则委员会（Sustainability Accounting Standards Board）指标，旨在向投资者提供具有财务重要性的信息。使用信息含量的标准衡量方法，我们无法找到有说服力的证据表明这些报告向投资者提供了大量新信息。对一组常见指标的进一步分析表明，它们要么在财务上不重要，要么已被传统财务披露所预先涵盖。最后，我们表明，大多数公司将其可持续发展报告的目标受众定位为广泛的以可持续发展为导向的利益相关者，而非狭窄的以财务为导向的投资者群体。

papers.abstract_original: Using federal judge ideology as an exogenous measure of issuing firms’ litigation risk, we document that the initial public offerings (IPOs) of the firms headquartered in more liberal circuits are more underpriced. The effect is mitigated when plaintiffs’ pleading standards are more stringent and is amplified when judges have more discretion in their decisions. The effect is also amplified among deep pocketed issuing firms, while it is mitigated among issuing firms hiring reputable intermediaries in the IPO process. The results of additional analysis suggest that issuing firms located in more liberal circuits are more likely to become targets of lawsuits after their IPOs and that these lawsuits are less likely to be dismissed by the courts and result in larger settlements. Collectively, our findings underscore the salience of litigation risk stemming from the issuing firms’ legal environment in driving IPO underpricing.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们使用联邦法官意识形态作为发行公司诉讼风险的外生度量，发现总部位于更自由派巡回区的公司，其首次公开发行（IPO）抑价程度更高。当原告的起诉标准更为严格时，这一效应会减弱；而当法官在裁决中拥有更大自由裁量权时，这一效应会放大。该效应在资金雄厚的发行公司中也更为放大，而在IPO过程中聘请声誉良好中介机构的发行公司中则有所减弱。进一步分析的结果表明，位于更自由派巡回区的发行公司在IPO后更有可能成为诉讼目标，且这些诉讼更不可能被法院驳回，并会导致更高的和解金额。总体而言，我们的发现凸显了源自发行公司法律环境的诉讼风险在驱动IPO抑价方面的重要性。

papers.abstract_original: We examine whether narrative discussion in financial disclosures can help corporate stakeholders better predict tax outcomes. To measure qualitative discussion, we use topic modeling analysis to create measures of the thematic content of 10-K disclosures. We find that qualitative discussion in financial disclosures can substantially improve prediction of tax outcomes in in- and out-of-sample tests. We also find that prediction-relevant discussion is distributed throughout the 10-K, supporting that disclosures should be analyzed holistically rather than examining only limited pieces of larger disclosures. Further, we find that analysts often do not use this information effectively, resulting in predictable and economically meaningful forecast errors. These findings illustrate the wealth of qualitative information in 10-K disclosures for stakeholders concerned about tax outcomes and offer a practical approach to examining qualitative disclosures and using them to predict tax outcomes.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考察财务披露中的叙述性讨论是否能够帮助公司利益相关者更好地预测税务结果。为衡量定性讨论，我们使用主题建模分析来构建10-K披露主题内容的度量指标。我们发现，财务披露中的定性讨论能够在样本内和样本外检验中显著改善对税务结果的预测。我们还发现，与预测相关的讨论分布于整个10-K之中，这支持了应当整体性地分析披露，而非仅考察较大披露中的有限片段。此外，我们发现分析师往往未能有效利用这一信息，从而导致可预测且具有经济意义的预测误差。这些发现表明，对于关注税务结果的利益相关者而言，10-K披露中蕴含着丰富的定性信息，并提供了一种考察定性披露并利用其预测税务结果的实用方法。

papers.abstract_original: Research suggests that board members value financial reporting quality because executive dismissal often follows low reporting quality events. However, inferences about the board’s demand for reporting quality in these studies are confounded by board members’ reputation incentives because the events examined are public (e.g., restatements). We investigate boards’ demand for reporting quality by exploiting a private signal of misreporting: audit adjustments communicated to the Board by the external auditor. We first survey 29 audit committee chairs to understand whether boards use audit adjustments in their oversight of management and then conduct an empirical investigation to answer our research question. We find an increased likelihood of CFO dismissal following audit adjustments. This association is driven by adjustments that reduce income and by firms with better board oversight. These findings suggest that boards proactively use nonpublic signals of reporting quality and incorporate information from auditors into their monitoring function.
papers.abstract_zh: 研究表明，董事会成员重视财务报告质量，因为高管解聘往往发生在低报告质量事件之后。然而，这些研究中关于董事会对报告质量需求的推断受到董事会成员声誉激励的干扰，因为所考察的事件是公开的（例如财务重述）。我们通过利用一个关于错报的私人信号来研究董事会对报告质量的需求：外部审计师向董事会传达的审计调整。我们首先调查了29位审计委员会主席，以了解董事会是否在其对管理层的监督中使用审计调整，然后进行实证研究以回答我们的研究问题。我们发现，在审计调整之后，首席财务官被解聘的可能性增加。这种关联是由减少收入的调整以及董事会监督更好的公司所驱动的。这些发现表明，董事会主动利用报告质量的非公开信号，并将来自审计师的信息纳入其监督职能。

papers.abstract_original: We provide early evidence of corporate responses to generative artificial intelligence (GAI) through managerial discussions of GAI in conference calls after ChatGPT’s release in November 2022. Following the release, these managerial discussions increase substantially, and most discussions have positive tone and contain action initiatives. The increase is more pronounced for larger firms, growth firms, younger firms, and those in high-tech industries. The largest increase is observed in the industry of business equipment—computers, software, and electronic equipment—while the utilities, chemicals and allied products, and oil, gas, and coal extraction industries experience the smallest increases. Managers of firms with greater innovation intensity (reflected in patent filings), cybersecurity threats, labor exposure to AI, and customer operations are more likely to increase GAI discussions. The results are primarily driven by positive-tone discussions and those with action initiatives. Analyst discussions of GAI exhibit similar patterns, except for patent filings. Finally, managers’ GAI discussions inform investors.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们通过2022年11月ChatGPT发布后管理层在电话会议中对生成式人工智能（GAI）的讨论，提供了企业对生成式人工智能回应的早期证据。在该产品发布之后，这些管理层讨论大幅增加，且大多数讨论具有正面语气并包含行动举措。这一增长在规模较大的企业、成长型企业、较年轻的企业以及高科技行业的企业中更为明显。增幅最大的是商业设备行业——计算机、软件和电子设备——而公用事业、化学品及相关产品，以及石油、天然气和煤炭开采行业的增幅最小。创新强度较高（体现在专利申请中）、面临网络安全威胁、劳动力受人工智能影响程度较高以及客户运营相关企业的管理者更可能增加对GAI的讨论。这些结果主要由正面语气的讨论以及包含行动举措的讨论所驱动。分析师对GAI的讨论呈现出类似模式，但专利申请除外。最后，管理者对GAI的讨论为投资者提供了信息。

papers.abstract_original: Companies’ strategic alternatives announcements lead to negative future stock returns. First, we investigate whether this anomaly exists. We demonstrate that it is significant and pervasive across years, industries, firm size, and information environments and that it is not driven by confounding variables nor risk. We then investigate why the market misprices the announcements and find that investors appear overly optimistic about a potential merger or acquisition and do not fully incorporate the negative fundamental news conveyed by the announcement. Meanwhile, short sellers exploit the mispricing. We also evaluate market frictions as limits to arbitrage. This study’s contributions are (i) evaluating behavioral and risk explanations for an event that causes extreme stock returns, (ii) challenging investors’ widely held belief that such announcements reflect good news, and (iii) warning investors and analysts about a behavioral bias they might unknowingly adopt.
papers.abstract_zh: 公司的战略替代方案公告会导致未来股票负收益。首先，我们考察这一异象是否存在。我们证明，该异象显著且普遍存在于不同年份、行业、公司规模和信息环境中，并且并非由混杂变量或风险所驱动。随后，我们探究市场为何会对这些公告错误定价，发现投资者似乎对潜在的合并或收购过于乐观，并未充分纳入公告所传达的负面基本面消息。与此同时，卖空者利用了这种错误定价。我们还评估了市场摩擦作为套利限制的作用。本研究的贡献在于：(i) 对一个引发极端股票收益的事件评估行为学与风险解释，(ii) 挑战投资者普遍持有的信念，即此类公告反映的是好消息，以及 (iii) 提醒投资者和分析师注意他们可能在不知不觉中采纳的一种行为偏差。

papers.abstract_original: U sing lenders who become members of the Task Force on Climate-Related Financial Disclosures (TCFD) as an exogenous shock, we examine whether and how lenders’ commitment to transparent climate-related disclosures affects borrowers’ environmental performance. We find that borrowers of TCFD-member lenders, relative to control firms, significantly improve their environmental performance after the TCFD launch. Lenders’ disclosure commitments influence borrowers through credit rationing and monitoring. Specifically, polluting borrowers face higher borrowing costs, reduced access to credit, and greater incorporation of environmental action covenants in loan agreements. Additionally, polluting borrowers of TCFD-member lenders experience heightened financial constraints. Finally, borrowers of TCFD-member lenders are more likely to adopt the TCFD framework for climate-related disclosure after the TCFD establishment. Together, these findings illuminate the role of lenders in driving corporate environmental performance improvement through their commitment to transparent climate-related disclosures.

papers.abstract_original: We examine the dynamic nature of the information content of aggregate earnings. Specifically, we examine how changes in supply elasticity affect the relation between aggregate earnings and future inflation. Using total capacity utilization to capture supply elasticity, we find that aggregate earnings are more informative about inflation when the supply is inelastic. This finding aligns with the investment demand hypothesis—higher aggregate earnings drive increased investment, pushing inflation higher, when supply is relatively inelastic. Furthermore, when we consider market outcomes such as three-month Treasury yields and aggregate stock returns, the role of supply elasticity pervades. That is, we find that aggregate earnings are more informative for market outcomes primarily when supply is inelastic. Finally, the relation between aggregate earnings and gross domestic product (GDP) also varies with the economy’s supply elasticity. Our findings highlight supply elasticity as a critical factor in interpreting the macroeconomic signals in aggregate earnings.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考察总体盈余信息含量的动态性质。具体而言，我们研究供给弹性的变化如何影响总体盈余与未来通货膨胀之间的关系。使用总产能利用率来刻画供给弹性，我们发现当供给缺乏弹性时，总体盈余对通货膨胀更具信息含量。这一发现与投资需求假说一致——当供给相对缺乏弹性时，更高的总体盈余推动投资增加，从而推高通货膨胀。此外，当我们考虑三个月期国债收益率和总体股票收益率等市场结果时，供给弹性的作用无处不在。也就是说，我们发现总体盈余主要是在供给缺乏弹性时对市场结果更具信息含量。最后，总体盈余与国内生产总值（GDP）之间的关系也随经济的供给弹性而变化。我们的发现凸显了供给弹性是解读总体盈余中宏观经济信号的关键因素。

papers.abstract_original: We examine the role of identity in corporate governance, focusing on an important dyad: audit committee chair and chief financial officer. Drawing on identity theory, which argues that people have lower trust in those they perceive to be different from themselves, we posit that the audit committee chair’s trust in the chief financial officer is lower when the two are different genders. We find that a gender difference between the two is associated with greater monitoring by the chair, consistent with lower trust. This effect is attenuated when a firm has value-based controls that promote diversity tolerance or when a chief financial officer seems more trustworthy. We find no evidence that the increased monitoring improves financial reporting. However, we find evidence that the increased monitoring generates negative externalities by distracting the chief financial officer, as proxied by lower operational performance. Our findings underscore the importance of identity in corporate governance.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考察身份在公司治理中的作用，聚焦于一个重要的二元组合：审计委员会主席与首席财务官。基于身份理论——该理论认为人们对自己感知为不同的人信任度较低——我们假设，当审计委员会主席与首席财务官性别不同时，主席对首席财务官的信任较低。我们发现，两者之间的性别差异与主席更大力度的监督相关，这与信任较低相一致。当公司拥有促进多样性包容的基于价值的控制，或当首席财务官看起来更值得信赖时，这一效应会减弱。我们没有发现证据表明监督力度的增加改善了财务报告。然而，我们发现证据表明，监督力度的增加通过分散首席财务官的注意力产生了负外部性，其代理变量为较低的运营绩效。我们的发现凸显了身份在公司治理中的重要性。

papers.abstract_original: Taxing companies’ goods or services where they are consumed, rather than where companies operate, limits tax avoidance and improves efficiency. However, such destination-based systems are hard to enforce. Therefore, in the European Union, value-added taxes on digital business-to-consumer (B2C) sales were historically based on the seller’s location or origin, allowing multinational companies to route sales through low-VAT countries. We study the impact of a 2015 reform that required multinationals to pay VAT where their consumers are. Difference-in-differences results suggest that they reported disproportionately high digital B2C services sales in low-VAT countries under the previous origin-based system. The introduction of the destination-based system curbed this tax planning behavior. While this baseline finding is consistent with expectations, we also provide novel evidence on potentially unintended or unexpected effects of system changes toward destination-based taxation. Specifically, we find that multinationals also decreased employment in low-VAT countries and increased income tax-motivated profit shifting post reform. In sum, our findings indicate that destination-based taxes curb corporate tax planning for mobile tax bases but that tax system changes have real effects and incentivize tax avoidance for other tax bases taxed at origin.
papers.abstract_zh: 在商品或服务被消费的地方而非公司经营的地方对公司征税，可以限制避税并提高效率。然而，此类基于目的地的制度难以执行。因此，在欧盟，数字企业对企业对消费者（B2C）销售的增值税历史上是基于卖方所在地或原产地的，这使得跨国公司能够通过低增值税国家进行销售。我们研究了一项2015年改革的影响，该改革要求跨国公司在消费者所在地缴纳增值税。双重差分结果表明，在此前基于原产地的制度下，它们在低增值税国家报告了不成比例高的数字B2C服务销售。基于目的地制度的引入遏制了这种税收筹划行为。虽然这一基准发现与预期一致，我们还提供了关于向基于目的地税收制度转变可能产生的意外或非预期效应的新证据。具体而言，我们发现跨国公司在改革后还减少了低增值税国家的就业，并增加了以所得税为动机的利润转移。总之，我们的发现表明，基于目的地的税收遏制了针对流动性税基的公司税收筹划，但税收制度变化具有实际效应，并激励了对其他按原产地征税的税基的避税。

papers.abstract_original: Securities regulators frequently punish firms for their managers’ misreporting. They argue that this would enhance firms’ long-term value by mitigating underinvestment in compliance mechanisms, such as internal controls over financial reporting. Opponents of corporate penalties argue that the penalties would harm the very same investors already harmed by misreporting. We evaluate these arguments in a model with a capital market-oriented misreporting manager and a board of directors that invests in internal control quality. We identify governance transparency and board dependence as key factors that moderate the firm-value effects of corporate penalties. Internal control underinvestment occurs only if the board is severely dependent and if its choice of internal controls is opaque. Then corporate penalties curb internal control underinvestment, but they only improve long-term firm value if, additionally, internal control costs are sufficiently small (e.g., in small and less complex firms). Overall, our differentiated results have implications for regulatory enforcement policies and empirical studies on the firm-value effects of public enforcement.
papers.abstract_zh: 证券监管机构经常因管理层错报而处罚公司。他们主张，这样做可以通过缓解对合规机制（如财务报告内部控制）的投资不足来提升公司的长期价值。反对公司处罚的人则认为，处罚会损害那些已经因错报而受损的投资者。我们在一个模型中评估这些论点，该模型包含一位以资本市场为导向的错报经理和一个对内部控制质量进行投资的董事会。我们识别出治理透明度和董事会依赖性，是调节公司处罚对企业价值影响的关键因素。只有当董事会严重依赖且其内部控制选择不透明时，才会出现内部控制投资不足。此时，公司处罚会抑制内部控制投资不足，但只有在内部控制成本足够小（例如，在规模较小且复杂度较低的公司中）的额外条件下，处罚才会提升企业长期价值。总体而言，我们的差异化结果对监管执法政策以及关于公共执法对企业价值影响的实证研究具有启示意义。

papers.abstract_original: We examine whether firms alter their financial reporting decisions during periods of increased regulatory scrutiny. A determinants analysis reveals that the likelihood of an enforcement action for firms investigated by the SEC increases (decreases) with pre-investigation levels of accounting manipulation and irregularities (accounting conservatism). Further, while executive turnover is positively associated with enforcement actions, firms that bring more accounting expertise into their executive ranks have a lower likelihood of being sanctioned. Next, we provide evidence suggesting that managers attempt to reduce the probability of enforcement by increasing conservatism and reducing manipulation and irregularities during the investigation. Finally, investigation firms are associated with adverse outcomes, including a reduction in investment and increases in executive turnover, lawsuits, restatements, and comment letters. Our study improves the understanding of how heightened regulatory scrutiny over financial reporting influences managerial behavior in terms of firms’ operating and financial reporting decisions, regardless of enforcement outcomes.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考察企业在监管审查加强期间是否会改变其财务报告决策。一项决定因素分析显示，对于被SEC调查的企业，调查前会计操纵和不规范行为的水平越高（越低），会计稳健性水平越高（越低），则受到执法行动的可能性越大（越小）。此外，尽管高管更替与执法行动正相关，但将更多会计专业人才引入高管层的企业受到处罚的可能性更低。接下来，我们提供的证据表明，管理者试图通过在调查期间提高稳健性并减少操纵和不规范行为来降低执法概率。最后，被调查企业伴随着不利结果，包括投资减少以及高管更替、诉讼、重述和意见函增加。我们的研究增进了对财务报告监管审查加强如何影响管理者在企业经营和财务报告决策方面行为的理解，无论执法结果如何。

papers.abstract_original: We investigate the role of politicians’ horizon incentives in banks’ response to a forward-looking provisioning model. We argue that horizon incentives, defined as the tendency of politicians to focus on short-term performance in the late stage of an official term, motivate banks to use the discretion of provisioning to obfuscate reporting. Using the mandatory shift to the expected credit loss model in China, we find that the increases in the magnitudes and timeliness of loan loss provisions following the mandatory shift are smaller for state-owned banks with late-term local governors than for other state-owned banks. Further, while the mandate reduces lending pro-cyclicality during the COVID-19 recession for state-owned banks without late-term governors prior to the recession, it has little impact on other state-owned banks. Overall, our findings suggest that politicians’ horizon incentives lead to opportunistic underreporting of provisions and damp the effectiveness of financial reporting regulation in reducing lending pro-cyclicality.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考察了政治人物的期限激励在银行对前瞻性拨备模型作出反应中所起的作用。我们认为，期限激励——定义为政治人物在官员任期后期倾向于关注短期业绩——会促使银行利用拨备的自由裁量权来模糊报告。利用中国强制转向预期信用损失模型这一事件，我们发现，与其他国有银行相比，对于地方主政官员处于任期后期的国有银行而言，强制转向之后贷款损失拨备的规模和及时性上升幅度更小。此外，虽然这一强制要求在新冠衰退期间降低了那些在衰退前没有任期后期主政官员的国有银行的贷款顺周期性，但对其余国有银行几乎没有影响。总体而言，我们的发现表明，政治人物的期限激励会导致机会主义地少报拨备，并削弱财务报告监管在降低贷款顺周期性方面的有效性。

papers.abstract_original: In 2016, the California Department of Insurance introduced a public database of carbon-intensive holdings of certain California-licensed insurers. The database lowers the cost to external stakeholders of assessing insurers’ carbon investments by removing the need to analyze complex statutory filings. Using a difference-in-differences design, I find that, after the introduction of the database, affected insurers (i.e., those included in the database) reduce their carbon-intensive holdings by approximately 14% relative to unaffected insurers. The reduction is more pronounced for insurers with harder-to-process statutory filings, greater public visibility, or operations in states with more climate-conscious stakeholders. In terms of insurers’ divestment consequences, I find that affected portfolio firms reduce bond offerings and capital expenditures following the database’s introduction. Overall, my findings suggest that enhancing transparency on institutions’ carbon-intensive investments helps redirect capital away from the carbon economy.
papers.abstract_zh: 2016年，加利福尼亚州保险局推出了一个公开数据库，收录了某些在加州获得执照的保险公司的碳密集型资产。该数据库降低了外部利益相关者评估保险公司碳投资的成本，因为无需再分析复杂的法定申报文件。我采用双重差分设计发现，在该数据库推出后，受影响的保险公司（即被纳入数据库的保险公司）相对于未受影响的保险公司，将其碳密集型资产减少了约14%。对于法定申报文件更难处理、公众可见度更高或在利益相关者更具气候意识的州运营的保险公司，这一减少更为明显。就保险公司撤资的后果而言，我发现受影响的投资组合公司在数据库推出后减少了债券发行和资本支出。总体而言，我的研究结果表明，提高机构碳密集型投资的透明度有助于将资本从碳经济中转移出去。

papers.abstract_original: We examine Twitter discussion of sell-side analysts’ stock recommendation revisions. While many investors lack direct access to analyst research, we observe revision-related Twitter discussion associated with approximately 90 percent of the revisions in our sample, usually within three hours of their announcement. Revision-related Twitter discussion is greater for upgrades and for analysts from larger brokerages. Examining within-revision intraday price discovery, we observe increased price discovery during intraday windows with more revision-related tweets, especially for tweets that have more user engagement, are posted by more influential authors, or involve stocks with more intense retail trading volume. We find that revision-related retail trading is more intense and better predicts future returns for revisions with more revision-related Twitter discussion. We observe no such evidence for institutional investors who have direct access to sell-side research. Our results suggest that Twitter is an important channel in facilitating price discovery following analyst revisions, particularly among retail investors.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考察了Twitter上对卖方分析师股票推荐调整的讨论。尽管许多投资者无法直接获取分析师研究，我们观察到，在我们样本中约90%的推荐调整都存在与调整相关的Twitter讨论，且通常在其公布后三小时内出现。与调整相关的Twitter讨论在评级上调以及来自规模较大券商的分析师中更多。通过考察调整事件内的日内价格发现，我们观察到在与调整相关的推文更多的日内时间窗口内价格发现增强，尤其是对于用户参与度更高、由更具影响力作者发布、或涉及散户交易量更活跃股票的推文。我们发现，对于与调整相关的Twitter讨论更多的推荐调整，与调整相关的散户交易更为活跃，且能更好地预测未来收益。对于能够直接获取卖方研究的机构投资者，我们未观察到此类证据。我们的结果表明，Twitter是促进分析师推荐调整后价格发现的重要渠道，尤其是在散户投资者中。

papers.abstract_original: We investigate changes in financial reporting conservatism arising from shareholder lawsuits. We find that sued firms respond to 10b-5 litigation with increased accounting conservatism. Consistent with a spillover effect, we also find that non-sued peer firms that share an auditor increase accounting conservatism following litigation. Despite the FASB having eliminated conservatism as an essential qualitative characteristic from the conceptual framework in 2010, we find the post-suit increase in conservatism persists after 2010, suggesting a capital market demand for conservatism even without regulator intervention. Our results, which support the notion that litigation can induce accounting conservatism, extend studies examining the disclosure effects of litigation into the accounting choice effects of litigation.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考察股东诉讼引起的财务报告稳健性变化。我们发现，被诉公司对10b-5诉讼的回应是会计稳健性提高。与溢出效应一致，我们还发现，与被诉公司共享审计师的未被诉同行公司在诉讼后提高了会计稳健性。尽管FASB已于2010年将稳健性作为一项基本质量特征从概念框架中删除，但我们发现，诉讼后稳健性的提高在2010年之后仍然持续，这表明即使没有监管机构干预，资本市场对稳健性仍有需求。我们的结果支持诉讼能够引致会计稳健性这一观点，并将考察诉讼披露效应的研究扩展到诉讼的会计选择效应。

papers.abstract_original: We explore reporting nonrecurring gains and losses (extraordinary and special items) among municipalities. We begin by documenting the nature, type, and frequency of reporting, finding that surprisingly few municipalities report items, including those with FEMA disasters and despite GASB standards. Results suggest municipalities with CPA-finance directors are significantly more likely to report items, while less likely reported among those led by unelected bureaucrats (council-manager political governance). Moreover, nonrecurring items are systematically associated with surpluses and deficits in a manner suggesting strategic reporting. Specifically, our evidence suggests officials report income-increasing nonrecurring items to reduce or avoid reporting deficits, and income-decreasing items to reduce surpluses. Strategic reporting is generally magnified when state laws allow direct voter initiatives and reduced when state laws mandate GAAP accounting or external audits. Overall, we conclude that accounting expertise and political governance structures are significant determinants of reporting nonrecurring items, and that some officials strategically report them.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了市政当局对非经常性损益（非常项目和特殊项目）的报告。我们首先记录了报告的性质、类型和频率，发现报告的市政当局少得惊人，包括那些遭受联邦应急管理署（FEMA）认定的灾难的市政当局，尽管有政府会计准则委员会（GASB）准则的要求。结果表明，由注册会计师（CPA）担任财务主管的市政当局报告此类项目的可能性显著更高，而在由非选举产生的官僚领导（议会-经理制政治治理）的市政当局中报告的可能性较低。此外，非经常性项目与盈余和赤字之间存在系统性关联，其方式表明存在策略性报告。具体而言，我们的证据表明，官员报告增加收入的非经常性项目以减少或避免报告赤字，并报告减少收入的项目以减少盈余。当州法律允许选民直接创制时，策略性报告通常会被放大；当州法律强制要求采用公认会计原则（GAAP）会计或外部审计时，策略性报告则会减少。总体而言，我们得出结论：会计专业知识和政治治理结构是报告非经常性项目的重要决定因素，并且一些官员会策略性地报告这些项目。

papers.abstract_original: Cryptocurrency has been the subject of heightened regulatory and investor attention in recent years, and regulators and policymakers across the globe are deliberating on how to account for, regulate, tax, and oversee digital assets and cryptocurrency marketplaces. Yet researchers have a limited understanding of key attributes of those who deal in crypto assets, such as whether their financial sophistication differs from that of other investors. Using U.S. administrative data, we provide evidence on (i) the attributes of taxpayers reporting cryptocurrency sales to the IRS, (ii) how these attributes are evolving, and (iii) how investors treat cryptocurrency versus other financial assets in certain settings. The results suggest that average reporting cryptocurrency sellers exhibit demographic attributes generally associated with less financial sophistication and are more likely to trade in meme stocks. Overall, we provide timely evidence that can inform cryptocurrency policy deliberations by highlighting the characteristics of taxpayers who appear to report cryptocurrency sales.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年来，加密货币一直是监管机构和投资者高度关注的焦点，全球各地的监管机构和政策制定者正在审议如何对数字资产和加密货币市场进行会计处理、监管、征税和监督。然而，研究者对从事加密资产交易者的关键特征——例如其金融素养是否与其他投资者不同——了解有限。我们利用美国行政数据，提供了关于以下方面的证据：(i) 向美国国税局报告加密货币销售的纳税人的特征，(ii) 这些特征如何演变，以及 (iii) 投资者在某些情境下如何对待加密货币与其他金融资产。结果表明，平均而言，报告加密货币销售的纳税人表现出通常与较低金融素养相关的人口统计特征，并且更有可能交易模因股票。总体而言，我们提供了及时的证据，通过突出那些似乎报告加密货币销售的纳税人的特征，为加密货币政策审议提供参考。

papers.abstract_original: The design science research (DSR) methodology, widely adopted in computer science and engineering, remains underutilized in accounting. DSR is designed to produce practice-relevant scholarship. We examine 51 DSR articles published in accounting journals and offer six recommendations to strengthen both authoring and peer review: follow a clear framework, validate the research question, state artifact objectives, diversify artifact types, evaluate rigorously, and report results clearly. These recommendations will help authors and reviewers enhance the quality and impact of DSR research in accounting and increase its publication in general interest journals.
papers.abstract_zh: 设计科学研究（DSR）方法在计算机科学和工程学中被广泛采用，但在会计领域仍未得到充分利用。DSR旨在产出与实践相关的学术成果。我们考察了发表在会计期刊上的51篇DSR文章，并提出六项建议，以加强作者撰写和同行评审：遵循清晰的框架、验证研究问题、阐明人工制品目标、多样化人工制品类型、严格评估，以及清晰报告结果。这些建议将帮助作者和评审人提升会计领域DSR研究的质量和影响力，并增加其在综合性期刊上的发表。

papers.abstract_original: This study documents the performance and career outcomes of sell-side analysts with prior accounting education or experience. Analysts with accounting work experience—especially former auditors—issue more accurate earnings forecasts and more profitable sell recommendations. In contrast, analysts with only accounting education or CPA credentials do not outperform. Former auditors also ask more accounting-focused questions during earnings calls, and the firms they cover exhibit higher earnings quality and more conservative reporting, consistent with improved monitoring. In terms of labor market outcomes, these analysts have longer tenures, are marginally more likely to attain all-star recognition, and are more often assigned to firms with complex financial reporting and greater analyst competition, suggesting strategic deployment. Overall, our findings highlight the value—but also the limits—of accounting expertise in sell-side research, particularly as it relates to information processing, capital market intermediation, and professional advancement.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究记录了具有先前会计教育或经验的卖方分析师的业绩和职业结果。具有会计工作经验的分析师——尤其是前审计师——发布的盈余预测更准确，卖出建议的盈利性更强。相比之下，仅具有会计教育或注册会计师（CPA）资格的分析师并未表现更优。前审计师在盈余电话会议中也会提出更多以会计为重点的问题，且他们所覆盖的公司表现出更高的盈余质量和更保守的报告，这与监督改善相一致。在劳动力市场结果方面，这些分析师的任期更长，获得全明星认可的可能性略高，且更常被分配到财务报告复杂、分析师竞争更激烈的公司，这表明存在战略性部署。总体而言，我们的发现凸显了会计专业知识在卖方研究中的价值——但也凸显了其局限——尤其是在其与信息处理、资本市场中介和职业晋升相关方面。

papers.abstract_original: This study examines whether the revolving-door phenomenon at financial intermediaries, specifically institutions sponsoring initial public offerings (IPOs), affects fraud allegations against their IPO clients in the Chinese market. We find that when sponsor institutions employ former China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC) regulators as board members or top managers, the CSRC is less likely to allege fraud against their clients. Evidence shows that this effect is caused more by a reduced probability of fraud detection than by a lower propensity to commit fraud, and that former regulators’ CSRC connections are more likely to drive this effect than their regulation expertise. Additional analyses show that former regulators also help sanctioned clients obtain lighter sanctions. Sponsor institutions benefit from employing former CSRC regulators by charging higher service fees, whereas the former regulators benefit from greater compensation. Finally, we find that while institutional investors see through the revolving-door phenomenon, retail investors do not.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究考察金融中介（具体而言是保荐首次公开发行（IPO）的机构）中的旋转门现象是否会影响中国市场上针对其IPO客户的欺诈指控。我们发现，当保荐机构聘请前中国证券监督管理委员会（CSRC）监管人员担任董事会成员或高级管理人员时，CSRC更不可能指控其客户存在欺诈。证据表明，这一效应更多是由欺诈被发现的概率降低所导致，而非欺诈实施倾向降低，且前监管人员的CSRC人脉比其监管专业知识更可能驱动这一效应。进一步分析表明，前监管人员还帮助受处罚的客户获得更轻的处罚。保荐机构通过收取更高的服务费从前CSRC监管人员的聘用中获益，而前监管人员则从更高的薪酬中获益。最后，我们发现，尽管机构投资者看穿了旋转门现象，但散户投资者没有。

papers.abstract_original: This paper examines the consequences of adopting ASC 606, a new revenue recognition standard, on revenue uncertainty and debt contracting, using a quasi-natural experiment surrounding its adoption. We find that affected firms experience an increase in revenue uncertainty, as indicated by both higher analyst forecast dispersion and absolute analyst forecast error. Consequently, the cost of debt rises for affected firms, as covenants are used less in debt contracts reflecting a decreased effectiveness of earnings-based covenants. The effect is mitigated by relationship lending. We also show that the decreased use of earnings-based covenants as well as the increased cost of debt dissipate over time, while the increase in revenue uncertainty persists. Our analyses document a costly transition toward a more principles-based accounting standard but also suggest that some costs are transient.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文利用围绕ASC 606（一项新的收入确认准则）采用所形成的准自然实验，考察了采用该准则对收入不确定性和债务契约的后果。我们发现，受影响企业的收入不确定性上升，这体现为分析师预测离散度更高以及分析师预测绝对误差更大。因此，受影响企业的债务成本上升，因为债务契约中较少使用契约条款，反映出基于盈余的契约条款有效性下降。关系型贷款缓解了这一效应。我们还表明，基于盈余的契约条款使用减少以及债务成本上升会随时间推移而消散，而收入不确定性的上升则持续存在。我们的分析记录了一项向更偏原则导向会计准则过渡所带来的代价，但也表明部分成本是暂时性的。

papers.abstract_original: We examine the role of conference calls in creating information spillover within firms. We find that analyst participation in conference calls is positively associated with subsequent revisions in management forecasts, consistent with analysts’ questions prompting managers to collect additional information. We find that this effect strengthens when analysts pose more questions on new topics and when they ask questions with abnormally positive or negative tones. We also find that analyst participation has greater effects when analysts have more experience and higher forecasting ability. Further analyses demonstrate that analyst participation is associated with higher accuracy in subsequently revised forecasts. Overall, our results illuminate how conference calls contribute to firms’ internal information environment.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考察电话会议在企业内部创造信息溢出方面的作用。我们发现，分析师参与电话会议与管理层预测的后续修正呈正相关，这与分析师的提问促使管理者收集额外信息相一致。我们发现，当分析师就新话题提出更多问题，以及当他们提出语气异常积极或消极的问题时，这一效应会增强。我们还发现，当分析师经验更丰富、预测能力更强时，分析师参与的影响更大。进一步的分析表明，分析师参与与随后修正预测的更高准确性相关。总体而言，我们的结果揭示了电话会议如何促进企业内部信息环境。

papers.abstract_original: The PCAOB adopted critical audit matters (CAMs) to meet public demand for informative audit disclosure, but stakeholders are concerned this goal has not been achieved. We explore this disconnect via interviews with 30 highly experienced auditors. We find that audit firms expended considerable resources to implement CAM best practices. However, overwhelming institutional pressure gave rise to informal rules of thumb that prioritize symbolic comfort over substantive change. The first is don’t be an outlier , so auditors defer to the national office to ensure conformity and avoid PCAOB scrutiny. The second is report the “right” number of CAMs by never reporting zero and reporting at least one recurring CAM. The third is avoid surprises by communicating with the client to ensure that CAMs do not contain original information and allowing management to preempt auditor disclosures. Collectively, these rules yield CAMs that comply with PCAOB standards but do not provide new information and instead maintain the status quo.
papers.abstract_zh: PCAOB采用关键审计事项（CAMs）以满足公众对信息性审计披露的需求，但利益相关者担心这一目标并未实现。我们通过对30位经验丰富的审计师进行访谈，探讨了这一脱节现象。我们发现，审计事务所投入了大量资源来实施CAM最佳实践。然而，压倒性的制度压力催生了非正式的经验法则，这些法则将象征性安慰置于实质性变革之上。第一条是不要成为异类，因此审计师遵从全国办公室以确保一致性并避免PCAOB的审查。第二条是通过从不报告零个CAM并至少报告一个重复出现的CAM来报告“正确”数量的CAM。第三条是通过与客户沟通以避免意外，确保CAM不包含原创信息，并允许管理层抢先于审计师的披露。总体而言，这些规则产生的CAM符合PCAOB标准，但不提供新信息，反而维持现状。

papers.abstract_original: Auditors informally communicate with both client managers and fellow audit team members throughout an audit. I examine the separate effects of these informal communications on managers’ strategic behavior using a laboratory experiment in which participants in the roles of auditors and managers interact in a stylized audit setting. I find that informal auditor-manager communication strengthens managers’ social bonds with auditors, which results in fewer aggressive accounting choices by the manager. Moreover, these stronger social bonds result in greater honesty about aggressive accounting choices when they do occur. While informal communication causes auditors to reduce audit effort, I show that the auditors’ choice is appropriate because of the positive influence the managers’ social bonds have on manager behavior, ultimately reducing instances of audit failure. My study demonstrates that auditors can strategically use informal communication with managers to strengthen auditor-manager social bonds that in turn benefit the audit through preferable manager behaviors.
papers.abstract_zh: 在整个审计过程中，审计师会与客户管理者以及审计团队同事进行非正式沟通。我通过一项实验室实验考察了这些非正式沟通对管理者策略行为的各自影响，实验中扮演审计师和管理者的参与者在一种程式化的审计情境中互动。我发现，审计师与管理者之间的非正式沟通增强了管理者与审计师之间的社会纽带，从而使管理者做出更少的激进会计选择。此外，这些更强的社会纽带使得管理者在确实发生激进会计选择时更加诚实。虽然非正式沟通导致审计师减少审计努力，但我表明审计师的选择是恰当的，因为管理者的社会纽带对管理者行为产生了积极影响，最终减少了审计失败的发生。我的研究表明，审计师可以策略性地利用与管理者的非正式沟通来增强审计师与管理者之间的社会纽带，而这反过来又通过更可取的管理者行为使审计受益。

papers.abstract_original: We examine whether information processing constraints limit managers’ ability to effectively integrate tax planning and core business strategies (i.e., effective tax planning). We propose that artificial intelligence (AI) tools, such as machine learning, can mitigate these constraints by providing enhanced predictive information for key business decisions (e.g., customer demand, supply chain), thereby reducing processing costs. Using a recently developed firm-year measure of investment in AI-related human capital for a broad sample of U.S. nontechnology firms between 2010 and 2018, we find that AI investment is positively associated with tax effectiveness. This effect is concentrated among more complex firms and those where the tax function holds a higher status. Consistent with AI reducing information processing costs, we find that it improves tax effectiveness by enhancing internal information quality and internal capital management. We provide novel evidence that processing constraints hinder effective tax planning and show that AI can mitigate these constraints.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考察信息处理约束是否限制了管理者有效整合税务筹划与核心业务战略（即有效税务筹划）的能力。我们提出，人工智能（AI）工具，如机器学习，可以通过为关键业务决策（例如客户需求、供应链）提供增强的预测信息，从而缓解这些约束，进而降低处理成本。我们使用最近开发的一项企业-年度AI相关人力资本投资衡量指标，对2010年至2018年间广泛的美国非科技企业样本进行研究，发现AI投资与税务有效性正相关。这一效应集中于更复杂的企业以及税务职能地位更高的企业。与AI降低信息处理成本相一致，我们发现AI通过提升内部信息质量和内部资本管理来提高税务有效性。我们提供了新的证据，表明处理约束会阻碍有效税务筹划，并表明AI可以缓解这些约束。

papers.abstract_original: Calls for greater transparency in PCAOB inspections have intensified amid persistent concerns about opacity and inconsistency. We integrate prior academic research with in-depth interviews from 29 former PCAOB inspectors to construct a detailed, phase-based account of the inspection process over global network firms. We organize insights into four sequential phases—hiring, training, and performance assessment; planning; execution; and resolution—and present structured taxonomies that combine the literature with novel, practice-based observations. The paper’s primary contribution lies in organizing fragmented research and insider perspectives into a framework that clarifies how inspections operate in practice and where further research is critical. This synthesis provides a structured foundation for researchers, practitioners, and regulators seeking to evaluate and strengthen audit oversight—at a time when the structure and independence of the PCAOB itself faces renewed political scrutiny.
papers.abstract_zh: 在人们对不透明性和不一致性的持续担忧中，要求提高PCAOB检查透明度的呼声日益高涨。我们将既有学术研究与对29名前PCAOB检查员的深度访谈相结合，构建了一份关于全球网络事务所检查流程的详细、分阶段的说明。我们将相关见解组织为四个依次展开的阶段——招聘、培训与绩效评估；计划；执行；以及解决——并提出了结构化的分类体系，将文献与基于实践的新观察相结合。本文的主要贡献在于将碎片化的研究和内部人士视角整合为一个框架，从而阐明检查在实践中如何运作，以及哪些方面亟需进一步研究。这一综合为试图评估和加强审计监管的研究人员、实务工作者和监管者提供了结构化的基础——而此时PCAOB自身的结构和独立性正面临新的政治审视。

papers.abstract_original: We examine the impact of auditors’ reputation impairments on their private-client market share to explore how conducting low-quality audits affects auditors’ broader client portfolios. Prior evidence implies that an audit office loses public-client market share after a client announces a restatement. However, auditors’ private clients may be less concerned about auditor reputation and quality, given that they have lower agency costs and their financial statement users are often creditors that can rely on direct monitoring to narrow information asymmetry. Also, differences between public and private company audits cast doubt on whether public-client restatements are relevant to private clients. We find that the private-client market share of a Big Four audit office falls by, on average, 5 percent the year after a public client announces a restatement. This evidence suggests that Big Four offices cannot simply replace lost public-client revenue with private-client revenue after suffering reputation damage.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考察审计师声誉受损对其私人客户市场份额的影响，以探究实施低质量审计如何影响审计师更广泛的客户组合。既有证据表明，在客户宣布重述后，审计分所会失去公共客户市场份额。然而，审计师的私人客户可能不太关心审计师声誉和质量，因为其代理成本较低，且其财务报表使用者往往是债权人，可以依赖直接监督来缩小信息不对称。此外，上市公司审计与私人公司审计之间的差异，使人们对公共客户重述是否与私人客户相关产生怀疑。我们发现，在一位公共客户宣布重述后的次年，四大审计分所的私人客户市场份额平均下降5%。这一证据表明，四大分所在遭受声誉损害后，不能简单地用私人客户收入来替代失去的公共客户收入。

papers.abstract_original: We investigate whether green innovators voluntarily provide innovation disclosure to reduce processing costs for stakeholders and gain green-specific disclosure benefits. We observe that green patenting firms provide more innovation disclosure in conference calls than do other innovating peers, controlling for patent value. Using a patent-call unit of analysis, we also provide within-firm evidence that managers highlight their green inventions more on conference calls relative to their other inventions. Green innovators provide more innovation disclosure when the costs of processing patent information are higher and anticipated disclosure benefits are greater. We find some evidence that innovation disclosure is positively associated with green fund ownership and stronger market responses to conference calls as well as proxies for ESG-related reputation. Our findings highlight both capital market and social capital benefits as motivating forces for voluntary innovation disclosure and suggest the nature of a firm’s innovations can impact its information environment.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究绿色创新者是否自愿提供创新披露，以降低利益相关者的处理成本并获取绿色特定的披露收益。我们观察到，在控制专利价值后，绿色专利企业在电话会议中提供的创新披露多于其他创新同行。以专利—电话会议为分析单元，我们还提供了企业内部证据，表明管理者在电话会议中相对于其他发明更突出地强调其绿色发明。当处理专利信息的成本更高且预期披露收益更大时，绿色创新者会提供更多创新披露。我们发现一些证据表明，创新披露与绿色基金持股以及电话会议更强的市场反应和ESG相关声誉的代理变量正相关。我们的发现凸显了资本市场收益和社会资本收益都是自愿性创新披露的驱动力量，并表明企业创新的性质可以影响其信息环境。

papers.abstract_original: This study focuses on CEOs’ capital gains taxes to shed light on how CEOs’ personal tax incentives influence corporate misconduct. We find strong evidence that CEOs’ capital gains tax liabilities are negatively associated with corporate misconduct. The results remain robust after controlling for potential endogenous effects. The effect of CEO capital gains taxes on corporate misconduct is attenuated when more of the CEO’s wealth is outside the firm and is concentrated among firms facing greater ex ante litigation risk. Overall, our findings suggest that CEOs’ capital gains taxes discipline corporate misconduct.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究聚焦于CEO的资本利得税，以揭示CEO的个人税收激励如何影响企业不当行为。我们发现强有力的证据表明，CEO的资本利得税负债与企业不当行为呈负相关。在控制潜在的内生性效应后，结果依然稳健。当CEO的更多财富位于企业之外时，CEO资本利得税对企业不当行为的影响会减弱，并且这种影响集中在事前诉讼风险更高的企业中。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，CEO的资本利得税对企业不当行为具有约束作用。

papers.abstract_original: This paper examines earnings management in response to changes in tax planning and financial reporting incentives around the corporate income tax rate decrease from 35% to 21% enacted by Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (TCJA) of 2017. Given the higher level of book-tax conformity of real activities manipulation (RAM) relative to accrual-based earnings management (AEM), we hypothesize that firms concertedly use these techniques for different purposes. Specifically, we predict and find that firms use RAM to reduce taxable income prior to the TCJA with firms in our sample saving between $9.1 billion and $11.0 billion in taxes by shifting taxable income from the high-tax to the low-tax period. We also predict and find that firms use AEM, which has lower book-tax conformity than RAM, to simultaneously increase book income in the high-tax period. These results inform policymakers, regulators, and researchers on the economic effects of corporate tax reform.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文考察了在2017年《减税与就业法案》（TCJA）将企业所得税税率从35%降至21%所引发的税收筹划和财务报告激励变化背景下，企业的盈余管理行为。鉴于真实活动操纵（RAM）相对于应计制盈余管理（AEM）具有更高的账面—税务一致性，我们假设企业会协同使用这些技术以实现不同目的。具体而言，我们预测并发现，企业在TCJA之前使用RAM来降低应税收入，样本中的企业通过将应税收入从高税率期间转移至低税率期间，节省了91亿至110亿美元的税款。我们还预测并发现，企业使用账面—税务一致性低于RAM的AEM，在高税率期间同时提高账面收入。这些结果为政策制定者、监管者和研究人员提供了关于企业税制改革经济效应的信息。

papers.abstract_original: We examine the influence of labor unions on non-GAAP reporting. We find managers are less likely to provide non-GAAP earnings disclosures after employees unionize. This relation arises because non-GAAP earnings metrics typically exclude expenses/losses and thus are higher than GAAP earnings. We also find some evidence that managers are more likely to disclose non-GAAP earnings metrics that are lower than GAAP earnings following unionization than they were prior to unionization. Additionally, we find decreased non-GAAP disclosure around unionization is associated with lower employee-related expenses and greater analyst forecast errors and dispersion. Overall, our results suggest managers modify their non-GAAP reporting to increase leverage in union negotiations, and these disclosure choices have real consequences. Our study extends the literature by examining managers’ strategic use of voluntary disclosure to present a negative outlook to unions. We also add to the literature by providing novel evidence on non-executive employee influence over non-GAAP disclosure.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们考察工会对非GAAP报告的影响。我们发现，在员工加入工会后，管理者提供非GAAP盈利披露的可能性更低。这一关系之所以出现，是因为非GAAP盈利指标通常剔除费用/损失，因而高于GAAP盈利。我们还发现一些证据表明，在工会化之后，管理者比工会化之前更可能披露低于GAAP盈利的非GAAP盈利指标。此外，我们发现，工会化前后非GAAP披露的减少与员工相关费用降低以及分析师预测误差和离散度增大相关。总体而言，我们的结果表明，管理者会调整其非GAAP报告，以在工会谈判中增加筹码，而这些披露选择具有实际后果。我们的研究通过考察管理者策略性地使用自愿披露向工会呈现负面前景，拓展了文献。我们还通过提供关于非高管员工对非GAAP披露影响的新证据，为文献作出贡献。

papers.abstract_original: We study India’s regulation requiring firms to create board-level CSR committees and spend 2% of profits on CSR initiatives targeting environmental sustainability and local socioeconomic development. We examine whether such a mandate can meaningfully enhance corporate social responsibility. We find significant improvements in environmental and social ratings of Indian firms relative to matched global peers, particularly in community engagement and natural resource stewardship. Outcome-based measures, such as waste and resource use, also indicate real effects. Notably, improvements occur only in firms that substantially increase CSR spending and establish independent, expert committees; firms that merely comply superficially show muted effects. Our findings suggest that, despite criticisms of mandated CSR as paradoxical or potentially rent-seeking, such regulations can effectively promote socially responsible business practices when implemented with sufficient commitment and oversight.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们研究了印度的法规，该法规要求企业设立董事会层面的企业社会责任委员会，并将利润的2%用于针对环境可持续性和当地社会经济发展的企业社会责任倡议。我们考察了此类强制要求能否切实增强企业社会责任。我们发现，相对于匹配的全球同行，印度企业在环境和社会评级方面有显著改善，尤其是在社区参与和自然资源管理方面。基于结果的衡量指标，如废弃物和资源使用，也表明存在真实效应。值得注意的是，改善仅发生在那些大幅增加企业社会责任支出并设立独立、专家型委员会的企业中；仅表面合规的企业则效应微弱。我们的发现表明，尽管有人批评强制企业社会责任是自相矛盾的或可能寻租，但此类法规在具备足够承诺和监督的情况下实施时，能够有效促进对社会负责任的商业实践。

papers.abstract_original: We analyze how incentives affect the reporting of fair values using mutual funds’ valuations of Level 3 equity holdings. We conjecture that the observed stickiness of reported values arises because funds defer revaluation until they can make a sufficiently compelling and objective case to avoid costly accusations of aggressive valuation. Consistent with our conjecture, we find that funds’ revaluations of the same security are clustered in time and tightly distributed, and revaluations of non-traded securities are more likely when market returns are larger and the source of those returns is less subjective. In addition, consistent with a greater concern for overvaluation, we document that funds are more likely to reduce valuations of these holdings when market returns are negative. Finally, given the stickiness of valuations, we provide evidence that funds exploit valuation discretion to improve performance rankings through the timing of revaluations rather than through the levels of new values.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们利用共同基金对第3层级权益持有的估值，分析激励因素如何影响公允价值的报告。我们推测，所报告价值中观察到的粘性之所以产生，是因为基金推迟重估，直到它们能够提出足够有说服力且客观的理由，以避免被代价高昂地指控为激进估值。与我们的推测一致，我们发现基金对同一证券的重估在时间上聚集且分布紧密，并且当市场回报更大且这些回报的来源更不主观时，非交易证券的重估更可能发生。此外，与对高估的更大担忧一致，我们记录到，当市场回报为负时，基金更可能下调这些持有的估值。最后，鉴于估值的粘性，我们提供证据表明，基金利用估值裁量权，通过重估的时机而非通过新价值的水平来改善业绩排名。

papers.abstract_original: This paper investigates how institutional investor distraction affects the assimilation of narrative content in the MD&A section of the 10-K filing. We introduce the Aggregate Attribute Index (AAI) and an alternative formulation (AltAAI), which capture linguistic features beyond tone to provide a broader measure of corporate narrative richness. Using machine learning and natural language processing, we analyze U.S. firms that follow a staggered reporting strategy, releasing quantitative results before full narrative disclosures. This design isolates the incremental effects of complex language when other portfolio events distract investors. We find that narrative complexity does not trigger short-term return responses but significantly affects stock prices over longer horizons. Complexity moderates how and when attention-constrained investors adjust prices. These effects are not captured by dictionary-based tone or readability metrics, underscoring the distinct role of multi-dimensional attributes in shaping delayed market reactions and price discovery.
papers.abstract_zh: 本文研究机构投资者分心如何影响对10-K申报文件中管理层讨论与分析（MD&A）部分叙述内容的吸收。我们引入聚合属性指数（AAI）及其替代形式（AltAAI），二者捕捉了语调之外的语言特征，从而提供对企业叙述丰富度的更广泛度量。我们运用机器学习和自然语言处理，分析采用交错报告策略、在完整叙述披露之前先发布定量结果的美国公司。这一设计在其它投资组合事件使投资者分心时，分离出复杂语言的增量效应。我们发现，叙述复杂性不会引发短期回报反应，但会在较长时期内显著影响股价。复杂性调节了受注意力约束的投资者调整价格的方式与时机。这些效应无法被基于词典的语调或可读性指标所捕捉，凸显了多维属性在塑造延迟市场反应与价格发现中的独特作用。

papers.abstract_original: We document that firms vary in their timeliness of support for the Black Lives Matter (BLM) movement following the death of George Floyd in May 2020, and that timeliness is an indicator of authenticity. We predict that firms that speak out quickly in support of BLM (via Twitter or their websites) have made more investments in diversity and inclusion, relative to firms that speak out slowly (via conference calls or annual reports) or that remain silent. Consistent with this prediction, quick -disclosing firms have greater workforce diversity, have boards with greater ethnic diversity, and are more likely to tie executive compensation to diversity and inclusivity. Furthermore, quick -disclosing firms increase their hiring of both Black American employees and Black directors relative to firms that stay silent. We also document that quick-disclosing firms are part of more supportive stakeholder networks. We develop an inclusivity index and show that firms with higher index levels are more likely to speak out on the Capitol Riots, the Asian Spa Shootings, and voting rights.
papers.abstract_zh: 我们记录到，在2020年5月乔治·弗洛伊德去世后，企业在支持“黑人的命也是命”（BLM）运动的及时性上存在差异，而这种及时性是真实性的一个指标。我们预测，相对于发声缓慢（通过电话会议或年度报告）或保持沉默的企业，迅速发声支持BLM（通过Twitter或其网站）的企业在多元化和包容性方面进行了更多投资。与这一预测一致，迅速披露的企业拥有更高的员工队伍多元化程度、拥有族裔多元化程度更高的董事会，并且更有可能将高管薪酬与多元化和包容性挂钩。此外，相对于保持沉默的企业，迅速披露的企业增加了对非裔美国员工和黑人董事的招聘。我们还记录到，迅速披露的企业属于更多支持性利益相关者网络的一部分。我们构建了一个包容性指数，并表明指数水平较高的企业更有可能就国会骚乱、亚裔水疗中心枪击事件和投票权发声。
